import Mathlib

open Filter Topology

namespace Erdos131

def NonDividing (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ S ⊆ A.erase a, S.Nonempty → ¬ a ∣ ∑ x ∈ S, x

instance (A : Finset ℕ) : Decidable (NonDividing A) := by
  unfold NonDividing; infer_instance

def F (N : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (((Finset.Icc 1 N).powerset).filter NonDividing).sup Finset.card

theorem exists_card_eq_F (N : ℕ) :
    ∃ A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N, NonDividing A ∧ A.card = F N := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, h⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup
    (((Finset.Icc 1 N).powerset).filter NonDividing)
    ⟨∅, by simp [NonDividing]⟩ Finset.card
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hA
  exact ⟨A, hA.1, hA.2, h.symm⟩

theorem card_le_F {N : ℕ} {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N) (hnd : NonDividing A) :
    A.card ≤ F N :=
  Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) (by simp [hA, hnd])

theorem F_le (N : ℕ) : F N ≤ N := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, -, h⟩ := exists_card_eq_F N
  simpa [← h] using Finset.card_le_card hA

theorem F_mono : Monotone F := fun _ _ hMN =>
  let ⟨_, hA, hnd, h⟩ := exists_card_eq_F _
  h ▸ card_le_F (hA.trans (Finset.Icc_subset_Icc_right hMN)) hnd

theorem one_le_F {N : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) : 1 ≤ F N := by
  have h := card_le_F (N := N) (A := {N}) (by simp [hN]) (by
    intro a ha S hS hne
    have : S = ∅ := by simpa [Finset.mem_singleton.1 ha] using hS
    simp [this] at hne)
  simpa using h

theorem erdos_131.variants.pham_zakharov :
    ∃ f : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, (F N : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + f N) := by
  sorry

theorem erdos_131 :
    ¬ ∃ f : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - f N) < (F N : ℝ) := by
  rintro ⟨f, hf, hlow⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hup⟩ := erdos_131.variants.pham_zakharov
  have hf' : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, f N < 1 / 8 := hf.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  have hg' : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, g N < 1 / 8 := hg.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num))
  obtain ⟨N, hN1, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ :=
    ((eventually_ge_atTop 1).and (hlow.and (hup.and (hf'.and hg')))).exists
  have hle : (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + g N) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - f N) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by exact_mod_cast hN1) (by linarith)
  linarith

end Erdos131

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

namespace Erdos210

open EuclideanGeometry Filter

noncomputable def f (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
    s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m}

theorem erdos_210.variants.green_tao : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n := by
  sorry

theorem f_le {n : ℕ} {s : Finset ℝ²} (hn : s.card = n)
    (hs : ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²)) : f n ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card :=
  csInf_le ⟨0, fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _⟩ ⟨s, hn, hs, rfl⟩

theorem triangle_not_collinear :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ ({!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]} : Set ℝ²) := by
  intro h
  have heq : (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0] : ℝ²) ≠ !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0] := by
    intro he
    have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 0) he
    norm_num at this
  have hm : (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 1] : ℝ²) ∈ line[ℝ, !₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]] :=
    h.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) heq
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hm
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 1) ht
  norm_num [AffineMap.lineMap_apply] at this

theorem exists_configuration {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  let t : Finset ℝ² := {!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]}
  have ht : t.card ≤ n := by
    calc
      t.card ≤ 3 := Finset.card_le_three
      _ ≤ n := hn
  obtain ⟨s, hts, hsn⟩ := Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq t n ht
  refine ⟨s, hsn, fun hs => triangle_not_collinear (hs.subset ?_)⟩
  intro p hp
  apply hts
  simpa [t] using hp

theorem f_attained {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧
      (ordinaryLines s).card = f n := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcol⟩ := exists_configuration hn
  apply csInf_mem (s := {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
    s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m})
  exact ⟨(ordinaryLines s).card, s, hs, hcol, rfl⟩

theorem le_f_iff {n m : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    m ≤ f n ↔ ∀ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n → ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      m ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h s hs hc => h.trans (f_le hs hc)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hcard⟩ := f_attained hn
    simpa [hcard] using h s hs hc

theorem erdos_210.variants.sylvester_gallai {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ f n := by
  apply (le_f_iff hn).mpr
  intro s _ hs
  exact (ordinaryLines_nonempty hs).card_pos

theorem tendsto_of_kelly_moser (h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) :
    Tendsto f atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max 3 (7 * m))] with n hn
  have hbound := h n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
  have hn' := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
  omega

theorem tendsto_of_green_tao (h : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) : Tendsto f atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  filter_upwards [h, eventually_ge_atTop (2 * m)] with n hn hm
  omega

def axisPoint (i : ℕ) : ℝ² := !₂[(i : ℝ), 0]

def apex : ℝ² := !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]

noncomputable def nearPencil (n : ℕ) : Finset ℝ² := by
  classical
  exact insert apex ((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint)

theorem axisPoint_injective : Function.Injective axisPoint := by
  intro i j h
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 0) h
  simpa [axisPoint] using this

theorem apex_ne_axisPoint (i : ℕ) : apex ≠ axisPoint i := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 1) h
  norm_num [apex, axisPoint] at this

theorem axisPoint_mem (i : ℕ) : axisPoint i ∈ line[ℝ, axisPoint 0, axisPoint 1] := by
  apply mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mpr
  refine ⟨(i : ℝ), ?_⟩
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [axisPoint, AffineMap.lineMap_apply]

theorem nearPencil_card {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (nearPencil n).card = n := by
  classical
  have hap : apex ∉ (Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    exact apex_ne_axisPoint i hi.symm
  rw [nearPencil, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hap, Finset.card_image_of_injective _
    axisPoint_injective, Finset.card_range]
  omega

theorem nearPencil_not_collinear {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ (nearPencil n : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  intro h
  apply triangle_not_collinear
  apply h.subset
  intro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  have haxis (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n - 1) : axisPoint i ∈ nearPencil n := by
    simp only [nearPencil, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image]
    exact Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_range.mpr hi, rfl⟩
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · simpa [axisPoint] using haxis 0 (by omega)
  · simpa [axisPoint] using haxis 1 (by omega)
  · change apex ∈ nearPencil n
    simp [nearPencil]

open scoped Classical in
theorem ordinaryLines_nearPencil_subset (n : ℕ) :
    ordinaryLines (nearPencil n) ⊆
      insert (line[ℝ, axisPoint 0, axisPoint 1])
        (((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).image fun p => line[ℝ, apex, p]) := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, rfl⟩, _⟩ := mem_ordinaryLines.mp hL
  simp only [nearPencil, Finset.mem_insert] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact (hab rfl).elim
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_comm⟩)
    · obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
      obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
      have heq := affineSpan_pair_eq_of_mem_of_mem_of_ne
        (axisPoint_mem i) (axisPoint_mem j) hab
      exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl heq)

theorem ordinaryLines_nearPencil_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (ordinaryLines (nearPencil n)).card ≤ n := by
  classical
  calc
    (ordinaryLines (nearPencil n)).card ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card (ordinaryLines_nearPencil_subset n)
    _ ≤ (((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).image
      fun p => line[ℝ, apex, p]).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).card + 1 :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ ≤ (Finset.range (n - 1)).card + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ = n := by rw [Finset.card_range]; omega

theorem erdos_210.upper_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : f n ≤ n :=
  (f_le (nearPencil_card (by omega)) (nearPencil_not_collinear hn)).trans
    (ordinaryLines_nearPencil_le (by omega))

theorem f_isBigO : (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 3] with n hn
  simpa using (Nat.cast_le.mpr (erdos_210.upper_bound hn) : (f n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ))

theorem linear_growth_of_kelly_moser (h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) :
    (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  refine ⟨f_isBigO, Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 7 ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 3] with n hn
  have hb := h n hn
  have hb' : n ≤ 7 * f n := by omega
  have hr : (n : ℝ) ≤ 7 * (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb'
  simpa using hr

theorem linear_growth_of_green_tao (h : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) :
    (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  refine ⟨f_isBigO, Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 2 ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h] with n hn
  have hr : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  simpa using hr

theorem collinear_of_card_lt_three {s : Finset ℝ²} (hs : s.card < 3) :
    Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  have hc : s.card = 0 ∨ s.card = 1 ∨ s.card = 2 := by omega
  rcases hc with hc | hc | hc
  · have he : s = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hc
    simpa [he] using collinear_empty ℝ ℝ²
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc
    simpa using collinear_singleton ℝ a
  · obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hc
    simpa using collinear_pair ℝ a b

theorem f_eq_zero_of_lt_three {n : ℕ} (hn : n < 3) : f n = 0 := by
  have he : {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
      s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m} = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro m ⟨s, hs, hc, _⟩
    exact hc (collinear_of_card_lt_three (by omega))
  simp [f, he]

theorem kelly_moser_iff : (∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) ↔
    ∀ s : Finset ℝ², ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      3 * s.card ≤ 7 * (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · intro h s hs
    have hn : 3 ≤ s.card := by
      by_contra! hn
      exact hs (collinear_of_card_lt_three hn)
    exact (h s.card hn).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 7 (f_le rfl hs))
  · intro h n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hf⟩ := f_attained hn
    simpa [hs, hf] using h s hc

theorem green_tao_iff : (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) ↔
    ∃ N : ℕ, 3 ≤ N ∧ ∀ s : Finset ℝ², N ≤ s.card →
      ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) → s.card ≤ 2 * (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp h
    refine ⟨max 3 N, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro s hs hc
    exact (hN s.card ((le_max_right _ _).trans hs)).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (f_le rfl hc))
  · rintro ⟨N, hN, h⟩
    apply eventually_atTop.mpr
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hf⟩ := f_attained (hN.trans hn)
    simpa [hs, hf] using h s (by simpa [hs] using hn) hc

theorem f_unique {n m : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hlower : ∀ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n → ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      m ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card)
    (hattain : ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧
      (ordinaryLines s).card = m) : m = f n := by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm ((le_f_iff hn).mpr hlower)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hm⟩ := hattain
  simpa [hm] using f_le hs hc

theorem eventually_even_exact
    (hl : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n)
    (hu : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n ≤ n) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n = n := by
  filter_upwards [hl, hu] with n hl hu
  intro hn
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (hu hn) hl

end Erdos210

variable (n T) in

def IsCuttable : Prop :=
  ∃ Ts : Fin n → Triangle ℝ ℝ²,
    (∀ i j, (Ts i).points ≅ (Ts j).points) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (Ts i).interior (Ts j).interior) ∧
      ⋃ i, (Ts i).closedInterior = T.closedInterior

lemma IsCuttable.ne_zero (hT : IsCuttable n T) : n ≠ 0 := by
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨Ts, -, -, hT⟩ := hT
  exact T.closedInterior_nonempty.ne_empty <| by simpa using hT.symm

lemma IsCuttable.of_isSquare (hn₀ : n ≠ 0) (hn : IsSquare n) : IsCuttable n T := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hn; rw [← sq]; exact .sq <| by simpa using hn₀

    (hTsides : LinearIndependent ℤ
      ![dist (T.points 0) (T.points 1),
        dist (T.points 1) (T.points 2),

        ∠ (T.points 2) (T.points 0) (T.points 1)]) :

import Mathlib

namespace Erdos210

open EuclideanGeometry Filter

noncomputable def f (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
    s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m}

theorem erdos_210.variants.even_upper_bound :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n ≤ n := by
  sorry

theorem f_le {n : ℕ} {s : Finset ℝ²} (hn : s.card = n)
    (hs : ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²)) : f n ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card :=
  csInf_le ⟨0, fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _⟩ ⟨s, hn, hs, rfl⟩

theorem triangle_not_collinear :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ ({!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]} : Set ℝ²) := by
  intro h
  have heq : (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0] : ℝ²) ≠ !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0] := by
    intro he
    have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 0) he
    norm_num at this
  have hm : (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 1] : ℝ²) ∈ line[ℝ, !₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]] :=
    h.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) heq
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hm
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 1) ht
  norm_num [AffineMap.lineMap_apply] at this

theorem exists_configuration {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  let t : Finset ℝ² := {!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]}
  have ht : t.card ≤ n := by
    calc
      t.card ≤ 3 := Finset.card_le_three
      _ ≤ n := hn
  obtain ⟨s, hts, hsn⟩ := Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq t n ht
  refine ⟨s, hsn, fun hs => triangle_not_collinear (hs.subset ?_)⟩
  intro p hp
  apply hts
  simpa [t] using hp

theorem f_attained {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧
      (ordinaryLines s).card = f n := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcol⟩ := exists_configuration hn
  apply csInf_mem (s := {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
    s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m})
  exact ⟨(ordinaryLines s).card, s, hs, hcol, rfl⟩

theorem le_f_iff {n m : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    m ≤ f n ↔ ∀ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n → ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      m ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h s hs hc => h.trans (f_le hs hc)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hcard⟩ := f_attained hn
    simpa [hcard] using h s hs hc

theorem erdos_210.variants.sylvester_gallai {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ f n := by
  apply (le_f_iff hn).mpr
  intro s _ hs
  exact (ordinaryLines_nonempty hs).card_pos

theorem tendsto_of_kelly_moser (h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) :
    Tendsto f atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max 3 (7 * m))] with n hn
  have hbound := h n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
  have hn' := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
  omega

theorem tendsto_of_green_tao (h : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) : Tendsto f atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  filter_upwards [h, eventually_ge_atTop (2 * m)] with n hn hm
  omega

def axisPoint (i : ℕ) : ℝ² := !₂[(i : ℝ), 0]

def apex : ℝ² := !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]

noncomputable def nearPencil (n : ℕ) : Finset ℝ² := by
  classical
  exact insert apex ((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint)

theorem axisPoint_injective : Function.Injective axisPoint := by
  intro i j h
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 0) h
  simpa [axisPoint] using this

theorem apex_ne_axisPoint (i : ℕ) : apex ≠ axisPoint i := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 1) h
  norm_num [apex, axisPoint] at this

theorem axisPoint_mem (i : ℕ) : axisPoint i ∈ line[ℝ, axisPoint 0, axisPoint 1] := by
  apply mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mpr
  refine ⟨(i : ℝ), ?_⟩
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [axisPoint, AffineMap.lineMap_apply]

theorem nearPencil_card {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (nearPencil n).card = n := by
  classical
  have hap : apex ∉ (Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    exact apex_ne_axisPoint i hi.symm
  rw [nearPencil, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hap, Finset.card_image_of_injective _
    axisPoint_injective, Finset.card_range]
  omega

theorem nearPencil_not_collinear {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ (nearPencil n : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  intro h
  apply triangle_not_collinear
  apply h.subset
  intro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  have haxis (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n - 1) : axisPoint i ∈ nearPencil n := by
    simp only [nearPencil, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image]
    exact Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_range.mpr hi, rfl⟩
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · simpa [axisPoint] using haxis 0 (by omega)
  · simpa [axisPoint] using haxis 1 (by omega)
  · change apex ∈ nearPencil n
    simp [nearPencil]

open scoped Classical in
theorem ordinaryLines_nearPencil_subset (n : ℕ) :
    ordinaryLines (nearPencil n) ⊆
      insert (line[ℝ, axisPoint 0, axisPoint 1])
        (((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).image fun p => line[ℝ, apex, p]) := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, rfl⟩, _⟩ := mem_ordinaryLines.mp hL
  simp only [nearPencil, Finset.mem_insert] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact (hab rfl).elim
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_comm⟩)
    · obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
      obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
      have heq := affineSpan_pair_eq_of_mem_of_mem_of_ne
        (axisPoint_mem i) (axisPoint_mem j) hab
      exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl heq)

theorem ordinaryLines_nearPencil_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (ordinaryLines (nearPencil n)).card ≤ n := by
  classical
  calc
    (ordinaryLines (nearPencil n)).card ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card (ordinaryLines_nearPencil_subset n)
    _ ≤ (((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).image
      fun p => line[ℝ, apex, p]).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).card + 1 :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ ≤ (Finset.range (n - 1)).card + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ = n := by rw [Finset.card_range]; omega

theorem erdos_210.upper_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : f n ≤ n :=
  (f_le (nearPencil_card (by omega)) (nearPencil_not_collinear hn)).trans
    (ordinaryLines_nearPencil_le (by omega))

  apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 3] with n hn
  simpa using (Nat.cast_le.mpr (erdos_210.upper_bound hn) : (f n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ))

  refine ⟨f_isBigO, Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 7 ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 3] with n hn
  have hb := h n hn
  have hb' : n ≤ 7 * f n := by omega
  have hr : (n : ℝ) ≤ 7 * (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb'
  simpa using hr

  refine ⟨f_isBigO, Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 2 ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h] with n hn
  have hr : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  simpa using hr

    Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  have hc : s.card = 0 ∨ s.card = 1 ∨ s.card = 2 := by omega
  rcases hc with hc | hc | hc
  · have he : s = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hc
    simpa [he] using collinear_empty ℝ ℝ²
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc
    simpa using collinear_singleton ℝ a
  · obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hc
    simpa using collinear_pair ℝ a b

theorem f_eq_zero_of_lt_three {n : ℕ} (hn : n < 3) : f n = 0 := by
  have he : {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
      s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m} = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro m ⟨s, hs, hc, _⟩
    exact hc (collinear_of_card_lt_three (by omega))
  simp [f, he]

theorem kelly_moser_iff : (∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) ↔
    ∀ s : Finset ℝ², ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      3 * s.card ≤ 7 * (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · intro h s hs
    have hn : 3 ≤ s.card := by
      by_contra! hn
      exact hs (collinear_of_card_lt_three hn)
    exact (h s.card hn).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 7 (f_le rfl hs))
  · intro h n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hf⟩ := f_attained hn
    simpa [hs, hf] using h s hc

theorem green_tao_iff : (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) ↔
    ∃ N : ℕ, 3 ≤ N ∧ ∀ s : Finset ℝ², N ≤ s.card →
      ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) → s.card ≤ 2 * (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp h
    refine ⟨max 3 N, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro s hs hc
    exact (hN s.card ((le_max_right _ _).trans hs)).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (f_le rfl hc))
  · rintro ⟨N, hN, h⟩
    apply eventually_atTop.mpr
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hf⟩ := f_attained (hN.trans hn)
    simpa [hs, hf] using h s (by simpa [hs] using hn) hc

theorem f_unique {n m : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hlower : ∀ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n → ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      m ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card)
    (hattain : ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧
      (ordinaryLines s).card = m) : m = f n := by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm ((le_f_iff hn).mpr hlower)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hm⟩ := hattain
  simpa [hm] using f_le hs hc

theorem eventually_even_exact
    (hl : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n)
    (hu : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n ≤ n) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n = n := by
  filter_upwards [hl, hu] with n hl hu
  intro hn
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (hu hn) hl

end Erdos210

namespace Erdos107

def cardSet (n : ℕ) := { N | ∀ (pts : Finset ℝ²), pts.card = N → NonTrilinear (pts : Set ℝ²) →
  HasConvexNGon n pts }

noncomputable def f (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf (cardSet n)

theorem f_zero_eq : f 0 = 0 := by
  have : ∀ P, HasConvexNGon 0 P := by
    intro; use ∅; simp [ConvexIndep]
  simp [f, cardSet, this]

private lemma convexIndep_triple_of_not_collinear {a b c : ℝ²}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hcoll : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℝ²)) :
    ConvexIndep ({a, b, c} : Set ℝ²) := by
  intro x hx hmem
  -- The point `x` lies in the affine span of `{a, b, c} \ {x}` because it
  -- lies in the convex hull of that two-element set.
  apply hcoll
  have hx_aff : x ∈ affineSpan ℝ (({a, b, c} : Set ℝ²) \ {x}) :=
    convexHull_subset_affineSpan _ hmem
  rw [show ({a, b, c} : Set ℝ²) = insert x (({a, b, c} : Set ℝ²) \ {x}) from
        (Set.insert_sdiff_self_of_mem hx).symm,
      collinear_insert_iff_of_mem_affineSpan hx_aff]
  -- The two-element complement is collinear.
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · rw [show ({x, b, c} : Set ℝ²) \ {x} = ({b, c} : Set ℝ²) by ext; aesop]
    exact collinear_pair ℝ b c
  · rw [show ({a, x, c} : Set ℝ²) \ {x} = ({a, c} : Set ℝ²) by ext; aesop]
    exact collinear_pair ℝ a c
  · rw [show ({a, b, x} : Set ℝ²) \ {x} = ({a, b} : Set ℝ²) by ext; aesop]
    exact collinear_pair ℝ a b

theorem f_three_eq : f 3 = 3 := by
  -- The substantive bound: 3 ∈ cardSet 3.
  have hmem3 : (3 : ℕ) ∈ cardSet 3 := by
    intro pts hpts hnontri
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, hab, hac, hbc, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hpts
    refine ⟨{a, b, c}, by simp [hab, hac, hbc], subset_refl _, ?_⟩
    have hcoerce : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²) : Set ℝ²) = ({a, b, c} : Set ℝ²) := by simp
    have hmem : ∀ {y : ℝ²}, y ∈ ({a, b, c} : Set ℝ²) →
        y ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²) : Set ℝ²) := fun h => hcoerce ▸ h
    have hnc : ¬ Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℝ²) :=
      hnontri (hmem (by simp)) (hmem (by simp)) (hmem (by simp)) hab hbc hac
    rw [hcoerce]
    exact convexIndep_triple_of_not_collinear hab hac hbc hnc
  refine le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le hmem3) (le_csInf ⟨3, hmem3⟩ fun N hN => ?_)
  -- A set with fewer than 3 points contains no 3-element subset.
  by_contra! hlt
  let f : ℕ → ℝ² := fun i => EuclideanSpace.single 0 (i : ℝ)
  let pts : Finset ℝ² := (Finset.range N).image f
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := fun i j hij => by
    have := congrArg (fun v : ℝ² => v 0) hij; simpa [f] using this
  have hpts_card : pts.card = N := by
    simp [pts, Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj.injOn]
  have hnontri : NonTrilinear (pts : Set ℝ²) := by
    apply Set.triplewise_of_encard_lt
    rw [Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard, hpts_card]
    exact_mod_cast hlt
  obtain ⟨S, hScard, hSsub, _⟩ := hN pts hpts_card hnontri
  have : S.card ≤ pts.card := Finset.card_le_card (by exact_mod_cast hSsub)
  omega

import Mathlib

open Affine

open scoped Congruent EuclideanGeometry Similar

namespace Erdos633

variable {n : ℕ} {T : Triangle ℝ ℝ²}

variable (n T) in

def IsCuttable : Prop :=
  ∃ Ts : Fin n → Triangle ℝ ℝ²,
    (∀ i j, (Ts i).points ≅ (Ts j).points) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (Ts i).interior (Ts j).interior) ∧
      ⋃ i, (Ts i).closedInterior = T.closedInterior

lemma IsCuttable.ne_zero (hT : IsCuttable n T) : n ≠ 0 := by
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨Ts, -, -, hT⟩ := hT
  exact T.closedInterior_nonempty.ne_empty <| by simpa using hT.symm

lemma IsCuttable.of_isSquare (hn₀ : n ≠ 0) (hn : IsSquare n) : IsCuttable n T := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hn; rw [← sq]; exact .sq <| by simpa using hn₀

lemma isCuttable_iff_isSquare_of_linearIndependent
    (hTsides : LinearIndependent ℤ
      ![dist (T.points 0) (T.points 1),
        dist (T.points 1) (T.points 2),
        dist (T.points 2) (T.points 0)])
    (hTangles : LinearIndependent ℤ
      ![∠ (T.points 0) (T.points 1) (T.points 2),
        ∠ (T.points 1) (T.points 2) (T.points 0),
        ∠ (T.points 2) (T.points 0) (T.points 1)]) :
    IsCuttable n T ↔ n ≠ 0 ∧ IsSquare n := by
  exact ⟨fun hT ↦ ⟨hT.ne_zero, sorry⟩, fun hn ↦ .of_isSquare hn.1 hn.2⟩

-- The complete classification is too involved to encode as the answer set here.

variable (n T) in

def IsSimiliCuttable (n : ℕ) (T : Triangle ℝ ℝ²) : Prop :=
  ∃ Ts : Fin n → Triangle ℝ ℝ²,
    (∀ i j, (Ts i).points ∼ (Ts j).points) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j ↦ Disjoint (Ts i).interior (Ts j).interior) ∧
      ⋃ i, (Ts i).closedInterior = T.closedInterior

lemma IsSimiliCuttable.ne_zero (hT : IsSimiliCuttable n T) : n ≠ 0 := by
  rintro rfl
  obtain ⟨Ts, -, -, hT⟩ := hT
  exact T.closedInterior_nonempty.ne_empty <| by simpa using hT.symm

theorem IsSimiliCuttable.of_ne_zero_two_three_five (hn₀ : n ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n ≠ 2) (hn₃ : n ≠ 3)
    (hn₅ : n ≠ 5) : IsSimiliCuttable n T := by
  sorry

end Erdos633

entries.statement: : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Odd n → 3 * (n / 4) ≤ f n
entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

namespace Erdos210

open EuclideanGeometry Filter

noncomputable def f (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
    s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m}

theorem erdos_210.variants.green_tao_odd :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Odd n → 3 * (n / 4) ≤ f n := by
  sorry

theorem f_le {n : ℕ} {s : Finset ℝ²} (hn : s.card = n)
    (hs : ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²)) : f n ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card :=
  csInf_le ⟨0, fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _⟩ ⟨s, hn, hs, rfl⟩

theorem triangle_not_collinear :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ ({!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]} : Set ℝ²) := by
  intro h
  have heq : (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0] : ℝ²) ≠ !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0] := by
    intro he
    have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 0) he
    norm_num at this
  have hm : (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 1] : ℝ²) ∈ line[ℝ, !₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]] :=
    h.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) heq
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hm
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 1) ht
  norm_num [AffineMap.lineMap_apply] at this

theorem exists_configuration {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  let t : Finset ℝ² := {!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]}
  have ht : t.card ≤ n := by
    calc
      t.card ≤ 3 := Finset.card_le_three
      _ ≤ n := hn
  obtain ⟨s, hts, hsn⟩ := Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq t n ht
  refine ⟨s, hsn, fun hs => triangle_not_collinear (hs.subset ?_)⟩
  intro p hp
  apply hts
  simpa [t] using hp

theorem f_attained {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧
      (ordinaryLines s).card = f n := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcol⟩ := exists_configuration hn
  apply csInf_mem (s := {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
    s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m})
  exact ⟨(ordinaryLines s).card, s, hs, hcol, rfl⟩

theorem le_f_iff {n m : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    m ≤ f n ↔ ∀ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n → ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      m ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h s hs hc => h.trans (f_le hs hc)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hcard⟩ := f_attained hn
    simpa [hcard] using h s hs hc

theorem erdos_210.variants.sylvester_gallai {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ f n := by
  apply (le_f_iff hn).mpr
  intro s _ hs
  exact (ordinaryLines_nonempty hs).card_pos

theorem tendsto_of_kelly_moser (h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) :
    Tendsto f atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max 3 (7 * m))] with n hn
  have hbound := h n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
  have hn' := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
  omega

theorem tendsto_of_green_tao (h : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) : Tendsto f atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  filter_upwards [h, eventually_ge_atTop (2 * m)] with n hn hm
  omega

def axisPoint (i : ℕ) : ℝ² := !₂[(i : ℝ), 0]

def apex : ℝ² := !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]

noncomputable def nearPencil (n : ℕ) : Finset ℝ² := by
  classical
  exact insert apex ((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint)

theorem axisPoint_injective : Function.Injective axisPoint := by
  intro i j h
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 0) h
  simpa [axisPoint] using this

theorem apex_ne_axisPoint (i : ℕ) : apex ≠ axisPoint i := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 1) h
  norm_num [apex, axisPoint] at this

theorem axisPoint_mem (i : ℕ) : axisPoint i ∈ line[ℝ, axisPoint 0, axisPoint 1] := by
  apply mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mpr
  refine ⟨(i : ℝ), ?_⟩
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [axisPoint, AffineMap.lineMap_apply]

theorem nearPencil_card {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (nearPencil n).card = n := by
  classical
  have hap : apex ∉ (Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    exact apex_ne_axisPoint i hi.symm
  rw [nearPencil, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hap, Finset.card_image_of_injective _
    axisPoint_injective, Finset.card_range]
  omega

theorem nearPencil_not_collinear {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ (nearPencil n : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  intro h
  apply triangle_not_collinear
  apply h.subset
  intro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  have haxis (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n - 1) : axisPoint i ∈ nearPencil n := by
    simp only [nearPencil, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image]
    exact Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_range.mpr hi, rfl⟩
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · simpa [axisPoint] using haxis 0 (by omega)
  · simpa [axisPoint] using haxis 1 (by omega)
  · change apex ∈ nearPencil n
    simp [nearPencil]

open scoped Classical in
theorem ordinaryLines_nearPencil_subset (n : ℕ) :
    ordinaryLines (nearPencil n) ⊆
      insert (line[ℝ, axisPoint 0, axisPoint 1])
        (((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).image fun p => line[ℝ, apex, p]) := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, rfl⟩, _⟩ := mem_ordinaryLines.mp hL
  simp only [nearPencil, Finset.mem_insert] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact (hab rfl).elim
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_comm⟩)
    · obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
      obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
      have heq := affineSpan_pair_eq_of_mem_of_mem_of_ne
        (axisPoint_mem i) (axisPoint_mem j) hab
      exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl heq)

theorem ordinaryLines_nearPencil_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (ordinaryLines (nearPencil n)).card ≤ n := by
  classical
  calc
    (ordinaryLines (nearPencil n)).card ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card (ordinaryLines_nearPencil_subset n)
    _ ≤ (((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).image
      fun p => line[ℝ, apex, p]).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).card + 1 :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ ≤ (Finset.range (n - 1)).card + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ = n := by rw [Finset.card_range]; omega

theorem erdos_210.upper_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : f n ≤ n :=
  (f_le (nearPencil_card (by omega)) (nearPencil_not_collinear hn)).trans
    (ordinaryLines_nearPencil_le (by omega))

theorem f_isBigO : (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 3] with n hn
  simpa using (Nat.cast_le.mpr (erdos_210.upper_bound hn) : (f n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ))

theorem linear_growth_of_kelly_moser (h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) :
    (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  refine ⟨f_isBigO, Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 7 ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 3] with n hn
  have hb := h n hn
  have hb' : n ≤ 7 * f n := by omega
  have hr : (n : ℝ) ≤ 7 * (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb'
  simpa using hr

theorem linear_growth_of_green_tao (h : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) :
    (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  refine ⟨f_isBigO, Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 2 ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h] with n hn
  have hr : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  simpa using hr

theorem collinear_of_card_lt_three {s : Finset ℝ²} (hs : s.card < 3) :
    Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  have hc : s.card = 0 ∨ s.card = 1 ∨ s.card = 2 := by omega
  rcases hc with hc | hc | hc
  · have he : s = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hc
    simpa [he] using collinear_empty ℝ ℝ²
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc
    simpa using collinear_singleton ℝ a
  · obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hc
    simpa using collinear_pair ℝ a b

theorem f_eq_zero_of_lt_three {n : ℕ} (hn : n < 3) : f n = 0 := by
  have he : {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
      s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m} = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro m ⟨s, hs, hc, _⟩
    exact hc (collinear_of_card_lt_three (by omega))
  simp [f, he]

theorem kelly_moser_iff : (∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) ↔
    ∀ s : Finset ℝ², ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      3 * s.card ≤ 7 * (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · intro h s hs
    have hn : 3 ≤ s.card := by
      by_contra! hn
      exact hs (collinear_of_card_lt_three hn)
    exact (h s.card hn).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 7 (f_le rfl hs))
  · intro h n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hf⟩ := f_attained hn
    simpa [hs, hf] using h s hc

theorem green_tao_iff : (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) ↔
    ∃ N : ℕ, 3 ≤ N ∧ ∀ s : Finset ℝ², N ≤ s.card →
      ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) → s.card ≤ 2 * (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp h
    refine ⟨max 3 N, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro s hs hc
    exact (hN s.card ((le_max_right _ _).trans hs)).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (f_le rfl hc))
  · rintro ⟨N, hN, h⟩
    apply eventually_atTop.mpr
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hf⟩ := f_attained (hN.trans hn)
    simpa [hs, hf] using h s (by simpa [hs] using hn) hc

theorem f_unique {n m : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hlower : ∀ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n → ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      m ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card)
    (hattain : ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧
      (ordinaryLines s).card = m) : m = f n := by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm ((le_f_iff hn).mpr hlower)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hm⟩ := hattain
  simpa [hm] using f_le hs hc

theorem eventually_even_exact
    (hl : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n)
    (hu : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n ≤ n) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n = n := by
  filter_upwards [hl, hu] with n hl hu
  intro hn
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (hu hn) hl

end Erdos210

def count (x : ℚ) (N : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  {A ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 N).powerset | ∑ n ∈ A, (1 / (n : ℕ) : ℚ) = x}.card

theorem count_one_five : count 1 5 = 1 := by decide +kernel

noncomputable def massIntegral (l : ℝ) : ℝ :=

def EverySevenHasTriangle {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), S.card = 7 → ∃ t ⊆ S, G.IsNClique 3 t

  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨t, htS, ht⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (show 3 ≤ S.card by omega)
  exact ⟨t, htS, ⟨(SimpleGraph.isClique_univ.2 rfl).subset (Set.subset_univ _), ht⟩⟩

theorem h_seven : h 7 = 3 := by
  -- The triangle on `{0, 1, 2}` together with four isolated vertices.
  set G : SimpleGraph (Fin 7) :=
    { Adj := fun v w => v ≠ w ∧ v.val < 3 ∧ w.val < 3
      symm := by constructor; intro v w h; exact ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.2, h.2.1⟩
      loopless := by constructor; intro v h; exact h.1 rfl } with hG
  have hmem3 : ∀ a : Fin 7, a ∈ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 7)) ↔ a.val < 3 := by decide
  have htri : G.IsNClique 3 ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 7)) := by
    constructor
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      exact ⟨hab, (hmem3 a).1 ha, (hmem3 b).1 hb⟩
    · decide
  have hclique : G.cliqueNum = 3 := by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ (htri.card_eq ▸ htri.isClique.card_le_cliqueNum)
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := G.exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
    rw [← hs.card_eq]
    by_cases hcard : s.card ≤ 1
    · omega
    · have hsub : s ⊆ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 7)) := by
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hne⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_ne (by omega : 1 < s.card) v
        exact (hmem3 v).2 (hs.isClique hv hw hne.symm).2.1
      simpa using Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have hESH : EverySevenHasTriangle G := by
    intro S hS
    have hU : S = Finset.univ := S.eq_univ_of_card (by simp [hS])
    exact ⟨{0, 1, 2}, hU ▸ Finset.subset_univ _, htri⟩
  have h3 : (3 : ℕ) ∈
      {k : ℕ | ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin 7), EverySevenHasTriangle G ∧ G.cliqueNum = k} :=
    ⟨G, hESH, hclique⟩
  refine le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le h3) (le_csInf ⟨3, h3⟩ ?_)
  rintro k ⟨G', hG', rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := hG' Finset.univ (by simp)
  exact ht.card_eq ▸ ht.isClique.card_le_cliqueNum

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

namespace Erdos68

theorem erdos_68 :
    Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n + 2).factorial - 1 : ℝ)) := by
  sorry

theorem sum_factorial_inv_eq_geometric :
    let f (n k : ℕ) : ℝ := 1 / ((n + 2).factorial : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)
    ∑' n : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / ((n + 2).factorial - 1) = ∑' n : ℕ, ∑' k : ℕ, f n k := by
  intro f
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  symm
  -- The inner sum is a geometric series with ratio r = ((n + 2)!)⁻¹.
  set r : ℝ := ((n + 2).factorial : ℝ)⁻¹ with hr_def
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by positivity
  have hr_lt_one : r < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by simp)
  -- Geometric series: HasSum (fun k ↦ r ^ k) ((1 - r)⁻¹)
  have hgeom := hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one hr_nonneg hr_lt_one
  -- Multiply by r to shift the index: HasSum (fun k ↦ r * r ^ k) (r * (1 - r)⁻¹)
  have hshift := hgeom.mul_left r
  -- Each summand satisfies f n k = r * r ^ k.
  have hf_eq : ∀ k, f n k = r * r ^ k := fun k => by simp only [f, hr_def]; ring
  -- Evaluate ∑' k, f n k = r * (1 - r)⁻¹ = 1 / ((n + 2)! - 1).
  exact ((hshift.congr_fun hf_eq).tsum_eq.trans (by simp only [hr_def]; field_simp))

end Erdos68

theorem erdos_1192.f_r_zero_zero (A : Set ℕ) : f_r A 0 0 = 1 := by
  dsimp [f_r]
  have h : { v : Fin 0 → ℕ | (∀ i, v i ∈ A) ∧ ∑ i, v i = 0 } = { default } := by
    ext v
    simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton]

  have h : { v : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ | (∀ i, v i ∈ (∅ : Set ℕ)) ∧ ∑ i, v i = n } = ∅ := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [h, Set.ncard_empty]

theorem erdos_1192.f_r_singleton_self (n : ℕ) : f_r {n} 1 n = 1 := by
  dsimp [f_r]
  have h : { v : Fin 1 → ℕ | (∀ i, v i ∈ ({n} : Set ℕ)) ∧ ∑ i, v i = n } = { fun _ ↦ n } := by

    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, _⟩

    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have h3 : v = fun _ ↦ 0 := by ext i; exact h1 i

    revert h2
    simp

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

namespace Erdos1129

def IsNodeSet {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  StrictMono x ∧ ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

noncomputable def lebesgueFunction {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k, |(Lagrange.basis Finset.univ x k).eval t|

theorem lebesgueFunction_eq {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    lebesgueFunction x t = ∑ k, |∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, (t - x i) / (x k - x i)| := by
  simp only [lebesgueFunction, Lagrange.basis, Lagrange.basisDivisor, Polynomial.eval_prod,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  congr 1
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [div_eq_inv_mul]

noncomputable def lebesgueConstant {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (lebesgueFunction x '' Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)

noncomputable def extendedNodes {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if h : 1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ n then x ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩ else if i = 0 then -1 else 1

noncomputable def gapMax {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (lebesgueFunction x '' Set.Icc (extendedNodes x i) (extendedNodes x (i + 1)))

def IsCanonical {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsNodeSet x ∧ (-1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.range x ∧ (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.range x

def IsMinimiser {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsNodeSet x ∧ ∀ y : Fin n → ℝ, IsNodeSet y → lebesgueConstant x ≤ lebesgueConstant y

def Equioscillates {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n - 1), ∀ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n - 1), gapMax x i = gapMax x j

def IsChebyshevNodes {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  IsNodeSet x ∧ ∀ j, (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (n : ℤ)).eval (x j) = 0

def erdos_1129.answer (n : ℕ) : Set (Fin n → ℝ) :=
  {x | IsNodeSet x ∧ Equioscillates x ∧
    lebesgueFunction x (-1) ≤ gapMax x 1 ∧ lebesgueFunction x 1 ≤ gapMax x 1}

theorem erdos_1129.variants.three_nodes :
    {x : Fin 3 → ℝ | IsCanonical x ∧ IsMinimiser x} = ({![(-1 : ℝ), 0, 1]} : Set (Fin 3 → ℝ)) ∧
      lebesgueConstant (![(-1 : ℝ), 0, 1] : Fin 3 → ℝ) = 5 / 4 := by
  sorry

end Erdos1129

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

namespace Erdos210

open EuclideanGeometry Filter

noncomputable def f (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
    s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m}

theorem f_le {n : ℕ} {s : Finset ℝ²} (hn : s.card = n)
    (hs : ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²)) : f n ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card :=
  csInf_le ⟨0, fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _⟩ ⟨s, hn, hs, rfl⟩

theorem triangle_not_collinear :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ ({!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]} : Set ℝ²) := by
  intro h
  have heq : (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0] : ℝ²) ≠ !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0] := by
    intro he
    have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 0) he
    norm_num at this
  have hm : (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 1] : ℝ²) ∈ line[ℝ, !₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]] :=
    h.mem_affineSpan_of_mem_of_ne (by simp) (by simp) (by simp) heq
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hm
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 1) ht
  norm_num [AffineMap.lineMap_apply] at this

theorem exists_configuration {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  let t : Finset ℝ² := {!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]}
  have ht : t.card ≤ n := by
    calc
      t.card ≤ 3 := Finset.card_le_three
      _ ≤ n := hn
  obtain ⟨s, hts, hsn⟩ := Infinite.exists_superset_card_eq t n ht
  refine ⟨s, hsn, fun hs => triangle_not_collinear (hs.subset ?_)⟩
  intro p hp
  apply hts
  simpa [t] using hp

theorem f_attained {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧
      (ordinaryLines s).card = f n := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcol⟩ := exists_configuration hn
  apply csInf_mem (s := {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
    s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m})
  exact ⟨(ordinaryLines s).card, s, hs, hcol, rfl⟩

theorem le_f_iff {n m : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    m ≤ f n ↔ ∀ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n → ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      m ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · exact fun h s hs hc => h.trans (f_le hs hc)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hcard⟩ := f_attained hn
    simpa [hcard] using h s hs hc

theorem erdos_210.variants.sylvester_gallai {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ f n := by
  apply (le_f_iff hn).mpr
  intro s _ hs
  exact (ordinaryLines_nonempty hs).card_pos

theorem tendsto_of_kelly_moser (h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) :
    Tendsto f atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max 3 (7 * m))] with n hn
  have hbound := h n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
  have hn' := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn
  omega

theorem tendsto_of_green_tao (h : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) : Tendsto f atTop atTop := by
  apply tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro m
  filter_upwards [h, eventually_ge_atTop (2 * m)] with n hn hm
  omega

def axisPoint (i : ℕ) : ℝ² := !₂[(i : ℝ), 0]

def apex : ℝ² := !₂[(0 : ℝ), 1]

noncomputable def nearPencil (n : ℕ) : Finset ℝ² := by
  classical
  exact insert apex ((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint)

theorem axisPoint_injective : Function.Injective axisPoint := by
  intro i j h
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 0) h
  simpa [axisPoint] using this

theorem apex_ne_axisPoint (i : ℕ) : apex ≠ axisPoint i := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun p : ℝ² => p 1) h
  norm_num [apex, axisPoint] at this

theorem axisPoint_mem (i : ℕ) : axisPoint i ∈ line[ℝ, axisPoint 0, axisPoint 1] := by
  apply mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mpr
  refine ⟨(i : ℝ), ?_⟩
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;> simp [axisPoint, AffineMap.lineMap_apply]

theorem nearPencil_card {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (nearPencil n).card = n := by
  classical
  have hap : apex ∉ (Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    exact apex_ne_axisPoint i hi.symm
  rw [nearPencil, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hap, Finset.card_image_of_injective _
    axisPoint_injective, Finset.card_range]
  omega

theorem nearPencil_not_collinear {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    ¬ Collinear ℝ (nearPencil n : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  intro h
  apply triangle_not_collinear
  apply h.subset
  intro p hp
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
  have haxis (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n - 1) : axisPoint i ∈ nearPencil n := by
    simp only [nearPencil, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image]
    exact Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_range.mpr hi, rfl⟩
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · simpa [axisPoint] using haxis 0 (by omega)
  · simpa [axisPoint] using haxis 1 (by omega)
  · change apex ∈ nearPencil n
    simp [nearPencil]

open scoped Classical in
theorem ordinaryLines_nearPencil_subset (n : ℕ) :
    ordinaryLines (nearPencil n) ⊆
      insert (line[ℝ, axisPoint 0, axisPoint 1])
        (((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).image fun p => line[ℝ, apex, p]) := by
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, rfl⟩, _⟩ := mem_ordinaryLines.mp hL
  simp only [nearPencil, Finset.mem_insert] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact (hab rfl).elim
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
  · rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
        (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_comm⟩)
    · obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
      obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
      have heq := affineSpan_pair_eq_of_mem_of_mem_of_ne
        (axisPoint_mem i) (axisPoint_mem j) hab
      exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl heq)

theorem ordinaryLines_nearPencil_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (ordinaryLines (nearPencil n)).card ≤ n := by
  classical
  calc
    (ordinaryLines (nearPencil n)).card ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card (ordinaryLines_nearPencil_subset n)
    _ ≤ (((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).image
      fun p => line[ℝ, apex, p]).card + 1 := Finset.card_insert_le _ _
    _ ≤ ((Finset.range (n - 1)).image axisPoint).card + 1 :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ ≤ (Finset.range (n - 1)).card + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    _ = n := by rw [Finset.card_range]; omega

theorem erdos_210.upper_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) : f n ≤ n :=
  (f_le (nearPencil_card (by omega)) (nearPencil_not_collinear hn)).trans
    (ordinaryLines_nearPencil_le (by omega))

theorem erdos_210.parts.ii :
    (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  sorry

theorem f_isBigO : (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 3] with n hn
  simpa using (Nat.cast_le.mpr (erdos_210.upper_bound hn) : (f n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ))

theorem linear_growth_of_kelly_moser (h : ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) :
    (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  refine ⟨f_isBigO, Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 7 ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 3] with n hn
  have hb := h n hn
  have hb' : n ≤ 7 * f n := by omega
  have hr : (n : ℝ) ≤ 7 * (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb'
  simpa using hr

theorem linear_growth_of_green_tao (h : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) :
    (fun n : ℕ => (f n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  refine ⟨f_isBigO, Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 2 ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [h] with n hn
  have hr : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  simpa using hr

theorem collinear_of_card_lt_three {s : Finset ℝ²} (hs : s.card < 3) :
    Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) := by
  classical
  have hc : s.card = 0 ∨ s.card = 1 ∨ s.card = 2 := by omega
  rcases hc with hc | hc | hc
  · have he : s = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hc
    simpa [he] using collinear_empty ℝ ℝ²
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hc
    simpa using collinear_singleton ℝ a
  · obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hc
    simpa using collinear_pair ℝ a b

theorem f_eq_zero_of_lt_three {n : ℕ} (hn : n < 3) : f n = 0 := by
  have he : {m : ℕ | ∃ s : Finset ℝ²,
      s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧ (ordinaryLines s).card = m} = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro m ⟨s, hs, hc, _⟩
    exact hc (collinear_of_card_lt_three (by omega))
  simp [f, he]

theorem kelly_moser_iff : (∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → 3 * n ≤ 7 * f n) ↔
    ∀ s : Finset ℝ², ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      3 * s.card ≤ 7 * (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · intro h s hs
    have hn : 3 ≤ s.card := by
      by_contra! hn
      exact hs (collinear_of_card_lt_three hn)
    exact (h s.card hn).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 7 (f_le rfl hs))
  · intro h n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hf⟩ := f_attained hn
    simpa [hs, hf] using h s hc

theorem green_tao_iff : (∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n) ↔
    ∃ N : ℕ, 3 ≤ N ∧ ∀ s : Finset ℝ², N ≤ s.card →
      ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) → s.card ≤ 2 * (ordinaryLines s).card := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp h
    refine ⟨max 3 N, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro s hs hc
    exact (hN s.card ((le_max_right _ _).trans hs)).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (f_le rfl hc))
  · rintro ⟨N, hN, h⟩
    apply eventually_atTop.mpr
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hf⟩ := f_attained (hN.trans hn)
    simpa [hs, hf] using h s (by simpa [hs] using hn) hc

theorem f_unique {n m : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (hlower : ∀ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n → ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) →
      m ≤ (ordinaryLines s).card)
    (hattain : ∃ s : Finset ℝ², s.card = n ∧ ¬ Collinear ℝ (s : Set ℝ²) ∧
      (ordinaryLines s).card = m) : m = f n := by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm ((le_f_iff hn).mpr hlower)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hc, hm⟩ := hattain
  simpa [hm] using f_le hs hc

theorem eventually_even_exact
    (hl : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, n ≤ 2 * f n)
    (hu : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n ≤ n) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, Even n → 2 * f n = n := by
  filter_upwards [hl, hu] with n hl hu
  intro hn
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (hu hn) hl

end Erdos210

theorem F_eq_one_of_lt_one {f : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hf : f n < 1) : F f n = 1 := by

namespace Erdos420

noncomputable def F (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (σ 0 (n + ⌊f n⌋₊).factorial : ℝ) / (σ 0 n.factorial : ℝ)

theorem F_eq_one_of_lt_one {f : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hf : f n < 1) : F f n = 1 := by
  have h : (σ 0 n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ArithmeticFunction.sigma_pos 0 _ (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)).ne'
  rw [F, Nat.floor_eq_zero.2 hf, add_zero, div_self h]

theorem one_le_F (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ F f n := by
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < σ 0 n.factorial := by
    exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.sigma_pos 0 _ (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  rw [F, one_le_div h0]
  simp only [ArithmeticFunction.sigma_zero_apply]
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (Nat.divisors_subset_of_dvd (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
    (Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial (Nat.le_add_right n _)))

theorem F_one_of_prime {n : ℕ} (hn : (n + 1).Prime) : F (fun _ ↦ 1) n = 2 := by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime (n + 1) n.factorial :=
    (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hn).2 fun h ↦ by
      have := (Nat.Prime.dvd_factorial hn).1 h
      omega
  have h0 : (σ 0 n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ArithmeticFunction.sigma_pos 0 _ (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)).ne'
  have hp : σ 0 (n + 1) = 2 := by
    simpa using ArithmeticFunction.sigma_zero_apply_prime_pow (i := 1) hn
  simp only [F, Nat.floor_one, Nat.factorial_succ,
    ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_sigma.map_mul_of_coprime hcop, hp]
  push_cast
  field_simp

    rintro x ⟨m, hm, hcomp, rfl⟩
    have h1 : 0 < m := by have := hcomp.1; omega

noncomputable def F (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (σ 0 (n + ⌊f n⌋₊).factorial : ℝ) / (σ 0 n.factorial : ℝ)

theorem F_eq_one_of_lt_one {f : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hf : f n < 1) : F f n = 1 := by
  have h : (σ 0 n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ArithmeticFunction.sigma_pos 0 _ (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)).ne'
  rw [F, Nat.floor_eq_zero.2 hf, add_zero, div_self h]

theorem one_le_F (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ F f n := by
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) < σ 0 n.factorial := by
    exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.sigma_pos 0 _ (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)
  rw [F, one_le_div h0]
  simp only [ArithmeticFunction.sigma_zero_apply]
  exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (Nat.divisors_subset_of_dvd (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)
    (Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial (Nat.le_add_right n _)))

theorem F_one_of_prime {n : ℕ} (hn : (n + 1).Prime) : F (fun _ ↦ 1) n = 2 := by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime (n + 1) n.factorial :=
    (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hn).2 fun h ↦ by
      have := (Nat.Prime.dvd_factorial hn).1 h

  have h0 : (σ 0 n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ArithmeticFunction.sigma_pos 0 _ (Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)).ne'
  have hp : σ 0 (n + 1) = 2 := by
    simpa using ArithmeticFunction.sigma_zero_apply_prime_pow (i := 1) hn
  simp only [F, Nat.floor_one, Nat.factorial_succ,
    ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_sigma.map_mul_of_coprime hcop, hp]
  push_cast
  field_simp

def EverySevenHasTriangle {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) : Prop :=
  ∀ S : Finset (Fin n), S.card = 7 → ∃ t ⊆ S, G.IsNClique 3 t

noncomputable def h (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {k : ℕ | ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n), EverySevenHasTriangle G ∧ G.cliqueNum = k}

theorem everySevenHasTriangle_top (n : ℕ) :
    EverySevenHasTriangle (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) := by
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨t, htS, ht⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (show 3 ≤ S.card by omega)
  exact ⟨t, htS, ⟨(SimpleGraph.isClique_univ.2 rfl).subset (Set.subset_univ _), ht⟩⟩

theorem h_seven : h 7 = 3 := by
  -- The triangle on `{0, 1, 2}` together with four isolated vertices.
  set G : SimpleGraph (Fin 7) :=
    { Adj := fun v w => v ≠ w ∧ v.val < 3 ∧ w.val < 3
      symm := by constructor; intro v w h; exact ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.2, h.2.1⟩
      loopless := by constructor; intro v h; exact h.1 rfl } with hG
  have hmem3 : ∀ a : Fin 7, a ∈ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 7)) ↔ a.val < 3 := by decide
  have htri : G.IsNClique 3 ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 7)) := by
    constructor
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      exact ⟨hab, (hmem3 a).1 ha, (hmem3 b).1 hb⟩
    · decide
  have hclique : G.cliqueNum = 3 := by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ (htri.card_eq ▸ htri.isClique.card_le_cliqueNum)
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := G.exists_isNClique_cliqueNum
    rw [← hs.card_eq]
    by_cases hcard : s.card ≤ 1
    · omega
    · have hsub : s ⊆ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 7)) := by
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hne⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_ne (by omega : 1 < s.card) v
        exact (hmem3 v).2 (hs.isClique hv hw hne.symm).2.1
      simpa using Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have hESH : EverySevenHasTriangle G := by
    intro S hS
    have hU : S = Finset.univ := S.eq_univ_of_card (by simp [hS])
    exact ⟨{0, 1, 2}, hU ▸ Finset.subset_univ _, htri⟩
  have h3 : (3 : ℕ) ∈
      {k : ℕ | ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin 7), EverySevenHasTriangle G ∧ G.cliqueNum = k} :=
    ⟨G, hESH, hclique⟩
  refine le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le h3) (le_csInf ⟨3, h3⟩ ?_)
  rintro k ⟨G', hG', rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := hG' Finset.univ (by simp)
  exact ht.card_eq ▸ ht.isClique.card_le_cliqueNum

theorem erdos_748.variants.lower_bound (n : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (f n : ℝ) := by
  classical
  -- Every subset of `(n/2, n]` is sum-free, and there are `2 ^ (n - n / 2)` of them.
  have hsub : (Finset.Ioc (n / 2) n).powerset ⊆
      (Finset.Icc 1 n).powerset.filter fun A : Finset ℕ ↦ IsSumFree (A : Set ℕ) := by
    intro A hA
    rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hA
    refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.mpr fun a ha => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (hA ha)
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, this.2⟩
    · rw [isSumFree_iff]
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      have h1 := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (hA (Finset.mem_coe.mp hx))
      have h2 := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (hA (Finset.mem_coe.mp hy))
      have h3 := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp (hA (Finset.mem_coe.mp hxy))
      omega

    have h := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_powerset, Nat.card_Ioc] at h
    unfold f
    convert h
  have hexp : (n : ℝ) / 2 ≤ ((n - n / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have h : n ≤ 2 * (n - n / 2) := by omega
    have h' : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((n - n / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    linarith
  calc (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n - n / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) hexp

    _ ≤ (f n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard

def maxLocalTime {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup fun k ↦ localTime X n ω (position X k ω)

theorem localTime_le_maxLocalTime {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω)
    (x : ℤ × ℤ) : localTime X n ω x ≤ maxLocalTime X n ω := by
  by_cases h : localTime X n ω x = 0
  · rw [h]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  · have hpos : 0 < ((Finset.range (n + 1)).filter fun k ↦ position X k ω = x).card :=
      Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Finset.card_pos.1 hpos
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hk
    rw [← hk.2]
    exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun j ↦ localTime X n ω (position X j ω)) hk.1

    (x : ℤ × ℤ) : x ∈ favouriteSites X n ω ↔ localTime X n ω x = maxLocalTime X n ω := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine le_antisymm (localTime_le_maxLocalTime X n ω x) ?_
    exact Finset.sup_le fun k _ ↦ hx _
  · intro h
    show ∀ y, localTime X n ω y ≤ localTime X n ω x
    intro y
    rw [h]
    exact localTime_le_maxLocalTime X n ω y

namespace Erdos304

def unitFractionExpressible (a b : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {k | ∃ s : Finset ℕ, s.card = k ∧ (∀ n ∈ s, n > 1) ∧ (a / b : ℚ) = ∑ n ∈ s, (n : ℚ)⁻¹}

@[simp]
lemma zero_mem_unitFractionExpressible_iff {a b : ℕ} :
    0 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b ↔ a = 0 ∨ b = 0 := by
  simp_all [unitFractionExpressible]

lemma unitFractionExpressible_of_zero {a b : ℕ} (h : a = 0 ∨ b = 0) :
    unitFractionExpressible a b = {0} := by
  simp only [Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem, zero_mem_unitFractionExpressible_iff, *]
  have : (a / b : ℚ) = 0 := by simpa
  simp only [unitFractionExpressible, gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
    true_and, this]
  rintro _ s rfl hs h
  rw [eq_comm, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i hi ↦ by positivity)] at h
  simp only [inv_eq_zero, Nat.cast_eq_zero] at h
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro i hi
  linarith [h i hi, hs i hi]

lemma unitFractionExpressible_zero_left {b : ℕ} :
    unitFractionExpressible 0 b = {0} := unitFractionExpressible_of_zero (by simp)

lemma unitFractionExpressible_zero_right {a : ℕ} :
    unitFractionExpressible a 0 = {0} := unitFractionExpressible_of_zero (by simp)

lemma zero_notMem_unitFractionExpressible {a b : ℕ} :
    0 ∉ unitFractionExpressible a b ↔ a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 := by
  simp_all [unitFractionExpressible]

lemma eq_inv_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible {a b : ℕ}
    (h : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b) : ∃ m : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ (a / b : ℚ) = (m : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
  simp only [unitFractionExpressible, gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.card_eq_one] at h
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨m, rfl⟩, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq, Finset.sum_singleton] at h₁ h₂
  use m

lemma dvd_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible {a b : ℕ}
    (h : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b) : a ∣ b := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm₁, hm⟩ := eq_inv_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible h
  have : b ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp [eq_comm] at hm
    omega
  use m
  field_simp at hm
  exact mod_cast hm.symm

noncomputable def smallestCollection (a b : ℕ) : ℕ := sInf (unitFractionExpressible a b)

-- in fact `(unitFractionExpressible a b).Nonempty` should always be true, but we do not prove it

-- for now

lemma smallestCollection_pos {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : (unitFractionExpressible a b).Nonempty) :
    0 < smallestCollection a b := by
  suffices smallestCollection a b ≠ 0 by omega
  intro h'
  have : 0 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b := h' ▸ Nat.sInf_mem h
  simp_all

lemma smallestCollection_left_one (b : ℕ) (hb : 1 < b) : smallestCollection 1 b = 1 := by
  have : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible 1 b := ⟨{b}, by simpa⟩
  have : smallestCollection 1 b ≤ 1 := Nat.sInf_le this
  have : 0 ∉ unitFractionExpressible 1 b := by simp; omega
  have : smallestCollection 1 b ≠ 0 := ne_of_mem_of_not_mem (Nat.sInf_mem ⟨_, ‹_›⟩) this
  omega

lemma eq_one_of_smallestCollection_eq_one {a b : ℕ}
    (h : smallestCollection a b = 1) : ∃ m : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ (a / b : ℚ) = (m : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
  have : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b := h ▸ Nat.sInf_mem (Nat.nonempty_of_sInf_eq_succ h)
  apply eq_inv_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible this

lemma dvd_of_smallestCollection_eq_one {a b : ℕ}
    (h : smallestCollection a b = 1) : a ∣ b := by
  have : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b := h ▸ Nat.sInf_mem (Nat.nonempty_of_sInf_eq_succ h)
  apply dvd_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible this

lemma smallestCollection_two_fifteen : smallestCollection 2 15 = 2 := by
  have h : 2 ∈ unitFractionExpressible 2 15 := by
    use {10, 30}
    norm_num [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_singleton]
  have : smallestCollection 2 15 ≤ 2 := Nat.sInf_le h
  have : 0 < smallestCollection 2 15 := smallestCollection_pos (by simp) (by simp) ⟨_, h⟩
  have : smallestCollection 2 15 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h'
    have := dvd_of_smallestCollection_eq_one h'
    norm_num at this
  omega

  sSup {smallestCollection a b | a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b}

    (fun b => (smallestCollectionTo b : ℝ)) =O[atTop]
      (fun b => Real.sqrt (Real.log b)) := by
  sorry

end Erdos304

theorem trivial_ub (n : ℕ) : F n ≤ n + √n := by
  have hkey : F n ≤ n + n.sqrt := by
    apply csSup_le'
    rintro x ⟨m, hm, hcomp, rfl⟩
    have h1 : 0 < m := by have := hcomp.1; omega
    have hsq : m.minFac ^ 2 ≤ m := Nat.minFac_sq_le_self h1 hcomp.2

    omega
  calc (F n : ℝ) ≤ ((n + n.sqrt : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkey
    _ = n + (n.sqrt : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
    _ ≤ n + √n := by

def walkInteriorSet {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) : Set V :=
  {x | x ∈ p.support ∧ x ≠ u ∧ x ≠ v}

structure CliqueSubdivision {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (r : ℕ) where
  branch : Fin r ↪ V
  path : ∀ e : CliqueEdge r, G.Walk (branch e.1.1) (branch e.1.2)

def ContainsCliqueSubdivision {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (r : ℕ) : Prop :=

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

open Filter Asymptotics Real

namespace Erdos17

def IsClusterPrime (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  p.Prime ∧
    ∀ {n : ℕ}, Even n → n ≤ (p - 3 : ℤ) →
      ∃ q₁ q₂ : ℕ, q₁.Prime ∧ q₂.Prime ∧
        q₁ ≤ p ∧ q₂ ≤ p ∧ n = (q₁ - q₂ : ℤ)

noncomputable def clusterPrimeCount (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.card {p : ℕ | p ≤ n ∧ IsClusterPrime p}

theorem erdos_17.variants.upper_BES {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) :
  (fun x ↦ (clusterPrimeCount x : ℝ)) =O[atTop] fun x ↦ x / (log x) ^ A := by
  sorry

theorem isClusterPrime_97_isLeast_non_cluster : IsLeast {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ ¬ IsClusterPrime p} 97 := by
  -- For a prime `p`, being a cluster prime is equivalent to a fully bounded
  -- (hence decidable) statement over `ℕ`: every even `n ≤ p - 3` is `q₁ - q₂`
  -- for primes `q₁, q₂ ≤ p`, which (since `n ≥ 0`) amounts to a prime `q₂ ≤ p`
  -- with `q₂ + n` again prime and `≤ p`.
  have cluster_iff : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
      (IsClusterPrime p ↔
        (∀ n ∈ Finset.range (p - 2), Even n →
          ∃ q₂ ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (Nat.Prime q₂) ∧ Nat.Prime (q₂ + n) ∧ q₂ + n ≤ p)) := by
    intro p hp
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, h⟩ n hn hev
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hn
      have hn3 : (n : ℤ) ≤ (p - 3 : ℤ) := by omega
      obtain ⟨q₁, q₂, hq1p, hq2p, hq1le, hq2le, heq⟩ := h hev hn3
      refine ⟨q₂, ?_, hq2p, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Finset.mem_range]; omega
      · have hq2n : q₂ + n = q₁ := by omega
        rw [hq2n]; exact hq1p
      · omega
    · intro h
      refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
      intro n hev hn3
      have hnp : n ≤ p - 3 := by omega
      have hnrange : n ∈ Finset.range (p - 2) := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_range]; omega
      obtain ⟨q₂, hq2r, hq2p, hq1p, hle⟩ := h n hnrange hev
      refine ⟨q₂ + n, q₂, hq1p, hq2p, hle, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hq2r; omega
      · push_cast; ring
  constructor
  · -- `97` is prime but not a cluster prime: the even number `88 ≤ 94` is not a
    -- difference of two primes `≤ 97`.
    refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    rw [cluster_iff 97 (by norm_num)]
    simp only [Nat.reduceSub, Finset.mem_range, Nat.reduceAdd, not_forall, not_exists, not_and,
      not_le]
    refine ⟨88, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    intro x xl hx xl
    suffices 9 < x by
      lia
    contrapose! xl
    interval_cases x <;> norm_num
    · contrapose hx
      exact Nat.not_prime_one
    · contrapose hx
      norm_num
  · -- `97` is a lower bound: every prime `< 97` is a cluster prime, so cannot lie
    -- in the set of non-cluster primes.
    rintro b ⟨hbp, hbnc⟩
    by_contra! hlt
    interval_cases b <;>
      first
        | exact absurd hbp (by decide)
        | exact hbnc ((cluster_iff _ (by norm_num)).mpr (by set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in decide))

end Erdos17

def maxLocalTime {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup fun k ↦ localTime X n ω (position X k ω)

theorem localTime_le_maxLocalTime {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω)
    (x : ℤ × ℤ) : localTime X n ω x ≤ maxLocalTime X n ω := by
  by_cases h : localTime X n ω x = 0
  · rw [h]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  · have hpos : 0 < ((Finset.range (n + 1)).filter fun k ↦ position X k ω = x).card :=
      Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Finset.card_pos.1 hpos
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hk
    rw [← hk.2]
    exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun j ↦ localTime X n ω (position X j ω)) hk.1

  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine le_antisymm (localTime_le_maxLocalTime X n ω x) ?_
    exact Finset.sup_le fun k _ ↦ hx _
  · intro h
    show ∀ y, localTime X n ω y ≤ localTime X n ω x
    intro y
    rw [h]
    exact localTime_le_maxLocalTime X n ω y

open Asymptotics Filter

namespace Erdos304

def unitFractionExpressible (a b : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {k | ∃ s : Finset ℕ, s.card = k ∧ (∀ n ∈ s, n > 1) ∧ (a / b : ℚ) = ∑ n ∈ s, (n : ℚ)⁻¹}

@[simp]
lemma zero_mem_unitFractionExpressible_iff {a b : ℕ} :
    0 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b ↔ a = 0 ∨ b = 0 := by
  simp_all [unitFractionExpressible]

lemma unitFractionExpressible_of_zero {a b : ℕ} (h : a = 0 ∨ b = 0) :
    unitFractionExpressible a b = {0} := by
  simp only [Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem, zero_mem_unitFractionExpressible_iff, *]
  have : (a / b : ℚ) = 0 := by simpa
  simp only [unitFractionExpressible, gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
    true_and, this]
  rintro _ s rfl hs h
  rw [eq_comm, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i hi ↦ by positivity)] at h
  simp only [inv_eq_zero, Nat.cast_eq_zero] at h
  rw [Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro i hi
  linarith [h i hi, hs i hi]

lemma unitFractionExpressible_zero_left {b : ℕ} :
    unitFractionExpressible 0 b = {0} := unitFractionExpressible_of_zero (by simp)

lemma unitFractionExpressible_zero_right {a : ℕ} :
    unitFractionExpressible a 0 = {0} := unitFractionExpressible_of_zero (by simp)

lemma zero_notMem_unitFractionExpressible {a b : ℕ} :
    0 ∉ unitFractionExpressible a b ↔ a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 := by
  simp_all [unitFractionExpressible]

lemma eq_inv_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible {a b : ℕ}
    (h : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b) : ∃ m : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ (a / b : ℚ) = (m : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
  simp only [unitFractionExpressible, gt_iff_lt, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Finset.card_eq_one] at h
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨m, rfl⟩, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq, Finset.sum_singleton] at h₁ h₂
  use m

lemma dvd_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible {a b : ℕ}
    (h : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b) : a ∣ b := by
  obtain ⟨m, hm₁, hm⟩ := eq_inv_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible h
  have : b ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp [eq_comm] at hm
    omega
  use m
  field_simp at hm
  exact mod_cast hm.symm

noncomputable def smallestCollection (a b : ℕ) : ℕ := sInf (unitFractionExpressible a b)

-- in fact `(unitFractionExpressible a b).Nonempty` should always be true, but we do not prove it

-- for now

lemma smallestCollection_pos {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : (unitFractionExpressible a b).Nonempty) :
    0 < smallestCollection a b := by
  suffices smallestCollection a b ≠ 0 by omega
  intro h'
  have : 0 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b := h' ▸ Nat.sInf_mem h
  simp_all

lemma smallestCollection_left_one (b : ℕ) (hb : 1 < b) : smallestCollection 1 b = 1 := by
  have : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible 1 b := ⟨{b}, by simpa⟩
  have : smallestCollection 1 b ≤ 1 := Nat.sInf_le this
  have : 0 ∉ unitFractionExpressible 1 b := by simp; omega
  have : smallestCollection 1 b ≠ 0 := ne_of_mem_of_not_mem (Nat.sInf_mem ⟨_, ‹_›⟩) this
  omega

lemma eq_one_of_smallestCollection_eq_one {a b : ℕ}
    (h : smallestCollection a b = 1) : ∃ m : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ (a / b : ℚ) = (m : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
  have : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b := h ▸ Nat.sInf_mem (Nat.nonempty_of_sInf_eq_succ h)
  apply eq_inv_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible this

lemma dvd_of_smallestCollection_eq_one {a b : ℕ}
    (h : smallestCollection a b = 1) : a ∣ b := by
  have : 1 ∈ unitFractionExpressible a b := h ▸ Nat.sInf_mem (Nat.nonempty_of_sInf_eq_succ h)
  apply dvd_of_one_mem_unitFractionExpressible this

lemma smallestCollection_two_fifteen : smallestCollection 2 15 = 2 := by
  have h : 2 ∈ unitFractionExpressible 2 15 := by
    use {10, 30}
    norm_num [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, Finset.card_singleton]
  have : smallestCollection 2 15 ≤ 2 := Nat.sInf_le h
  have : 0 < smallestCollection 2 15 := smallestCollection_pos (by simp) (by simp) ⟨_, h⟩
  have : smallestCollection 2 15 ≠ 1 := by
    intro h'
    have := dvd_of_smallestCollection_eq_one h'
    norm_num at this
  omega

noncomputable def smallestCollectionTo (b : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sSup {smallestCollection a b | a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b}

    (fun b => (smallestCollectionTo b : ℝ)) =O[atTop]
      (fun b => Real.log b / Real.log (Real.log b)) := by
  sorry

end Erdos304

def IsNodeSet {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) : Prop :=
  StrictMono x ∧ ∀ i, x i ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1

noncomputable def lebesgueFunction {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k, |(Lagrange.basis Finset.univ x k).eval t|

theorem lebesgueFunction_eq {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    lebesgueFunction x t = ∑ k, |∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, (t - x i) / (x k - x i)| := by
  simp only [lebesgueFunction, Lagrange.basis, Lagrange.basisDivisor, Polynomial.eval_prod,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_X]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  congr 1
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [div_eq_inv_mul]

open Filter

namespace Erdos382

def LargestPrimeRepeated (u v : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ v ∧ 2 ≤ v ∧
    Nat.maxPrimeFac (∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m) ^ 2 ∣ ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m

theorem largestPrimeRepeated_48_50 : LargestPrimeRepeated 48 50 := by
  unfold LargestPrimeRepeated
  decide +kernel

theorem lt_two_mul_of_largestPrimeRepeated {u v : ℕ} (h : LargestPrimeRepeated u v) :
    v < 2 * u := by
  obtain ⟨hu, -, hv, hdvd⟩ := h
  by_contra! hle
  have hP0 : ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun m hm ↦ by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm).1; omega
  -- Bertrand's postulate gives a prime `q` with `v / 2 < q ≤ v`, so `u ≤ q ≤ v`.
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1, hq2⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_lt_and_le_two_mul (v / 2) (by omega)
  have hqP : q ∣ ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m :=
    Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
  have hP1 : 1 < ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hq.one_lt (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hP0) hqP)
  -- The largest prime factor `p` satisfies `q ≤ p`, so `v < 2 * p`.
  set p := Nat.maxPrimeFac (∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m)
  have hp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_maxPrimeFac_of_one_lt _ hP1
  have hpq : q ≤ p := Nat.le_maxPrimeFac hP0 hq hqP
  have hv2 : v < 2 * p := by omega
  -- Hence `p` is the only multiple of `p` in `[u, v]`.
  have key : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, p ∣ m → m = p := by
    rintro m hm ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have hm' := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 2 with hk | hk
    · interval_cases k <;> omega
    · have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p hk
      linarith [hm'.2]
  have hpmem : p ∈ Finset.Icc u v := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hpm⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff hp.prime _).1
      (Nat.maxPrimeFac_dvd (n := ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m))
    rwa [← key m hm hpm]
  -- Write the product as `p * R`. Then `p ^ 2` divides it only if `p ∣ R`, which is impossible.
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ hpmem, pow_two] at hdvd
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hpm⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff hp.prime _).1
    ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hp.ne_zero).1 hdvd)
  exact (Finset.mem_erase.1 hm).1 (key m (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hm) hpm)

      ((v - u : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (v : ℝ) ^ ε := by
  sorry

end Erdos382

theorem erdos_644.variants.elementary_upper_bound (k r : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    Hypergraph.subfamilyTransversalBound k r 2 ≤ ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
  classical
  unfold Hypergraph.subfamilyTransversalBound
  refine iInf_le_of_le (2 * k) (iInf_le_of_le ?_ le_rfl)
  intro V F hu hl
  have hthree {e f g : Finset V} (he : e ∈ F) (hf : f ∈ F) (hg : g ∈ F)
      (hef : Disjoint e f) (heg : Disjoint e g) (hfg : Disjoint f g) : False := by
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hhit⟩ := hl {e, f, g} (by
      simpa only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.insert_subset_iff,
        Set.singleton_subset_iff] using And.intro he (And.intro hf hg))
      (Finset.card_le_three.trans hr)
    obtain ⟨x, hxS, hxe⟩ := hhit e (by simp)
    obtain ⟨y, hyS, hyf⟩ := hhit f (by simp)
    obtain ⟨z, hzS, hzg⟩ := hhit g (by simp)
    have hxy : x ≠ y := fun h ↦ Finset.disjoint_left.mp hef hxe (h.symm ▸ hyf)
    have hxz : x ≠ z := fun h ↦ Finset.disjoint_left.mp heg hxe (h.symm ▸ hzg)
    have hyz : y ≠ z := fun h ↦ Finset.disjoint_left.mp hfg hyf (h.symm ▸ hzg)
    have := Finset.card_le_card (show {x, y, z} ⊆ S by
      simpa only [Finset.insert_subset_iff, Finset.singleton_subset_iff] using
        And.intro hxS (And.intro hyS hzS))
    simp [hxy, hxz, hyz] at this
    omega
  by_cases hF : F.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hF
    by_cases hall : ∀ f ∈ F, ¬ Disjoint e f
    · refine ⟨e, by rw [hu e he]; omega, ?_⟩
      intro f hf
      simpa [Finset.not_disjoint_iff] using hall f hf
    · push Not at hall
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hef⟩ := hall
      refine ⟨e ∪ f, (Finset.card_union_le e f).trans (by rw [hu e he, hu f hf]; omega), ?_⟩
      intro g hg
      by_contra h
      have heg : Disjoint e g := Finset.disjoint_left.mpr (by
        intro x hxe hxg
        exact h ⟨x, Finset.mem_union_left f hxe, hxg⟩)
      have hfg : Disjoint f g := Finset.disjoint_left.mpr (by
        intro x hxf hxg
        exact h ⟨x, Finset.mem_union_right e hxf, hxg⟩)
      exact hthree he hf hg hef heg hfg
  · exact ⟨∅, by simp, fun e he ↦ (hF ⟨e, he⟩).elim⟩

    Hypergraph.subfamilyTransversalBound k r 2 < ⊤ :=
