import Mathlib

open Filter

namespace Erdos382

def LargestPrimeRepeated (u v : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ v ∧ 2 ≤ v ∧
    Nat.maxPrimeFac (∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m) ^ 2 ∣ ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m

theorem largestPrimeRepeated_48_50 : LargestPrimeRepeated 48 50 := by
  unfold LargestPrimeRepeated
  decide +kernel

theorem lt_two_mul_of_largestPrimeRepeated {u v : ℕ} (h : LargestPrimeRepeated u v) :
    v < 2 * u := by
  obtain ⟨hu, -, hv, hdvd⟩ := h
  by_contra! hle
  have hP0 : ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun m hm ↦ by have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm).1; omega
  -- Bertrand's postulate gives a prime `q` with `v / 2 < q ≤ v`, so `u ≤ q ≤ v`.
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq1, hq2⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_lt_and_le_two_mul (v / 2) (by omega)
  have hqP : q ∣ ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m :=
    Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
  have hP1 : 1 < ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hq.one_lt (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hP0) hqP)
  -- The largest prime factor `p` satisfies `q ≤ p`, so `v < 2 * p`.
  set p := Nat.maxPrimeFac (∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m)
  have hp : p.Prime := Nat.prime_maxPrimeFac_of_one_lt _ hP1
  have hpq : q ≤ p := Nat.le_maxPrimeFac hP0 hq hqP
  have hv2 : v < 2 * p := by omega
  -- Hence `p` is the only multiple of `p` in `[u, v]`.
  have key : ∀ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, p ∣ m → m = p := by
    rintro m hm ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have hm' := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hm
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 2 with hk | hk
    · interval_cases k <;> omega
    · have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p hk
      linarith [hm'.2]
  have hpmem : p ∈ Finset.Icc u v := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hpm⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff hp.prime _).1
      (Nat.maxPrimeFac_dvd (n := ∏ m ∈ Finset.Icc u v, m))
    rwa [← key m hm hpm]
  -- Write the product as `p * R`. Then `p ^ 2` divides it only if `p ∣ R`, which is impossible.
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ hpmem, pow_two] at hdvd
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hpm⟩ := (Prime.dvd_finsetProd_iff hp.prime _).1
    ((mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hp.ne_zero).1 hdvd)
  exact (Finset.mem_erase.1 hm).1 (key m (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hm) hpm)

def f (N : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.powersetCard (Nat.sqrt N) (Finset.Icc 1 N)).sup
    fun A ↦ #((A + A) ∩ Finset.Icc 1 N)

theorem f_le (N : ℕ) : f N ≤ N := by
  refine Finset.sup_le fun A _ ↦ ?_
  calc #((A + A) ∩ Finset.Icc 1 N) ≤ #(Finset.Icc 1 N) :=
        Finset.card_le_card Finset.inter_subset_right
    _ = N := by simp

theorem card_add_self_le (A : Finset ℕ) : #(A + A) ≤ (#A + 1).choose 2 := by
  rw [← Finset.card_sym2]
  calc #(A + A) ≤ #(A.sym2.image (Sym2.lift ⟨fun a b ↦ a + b, fun a b ↦ add_comm a b⟩)) := by
        refine Finset.card_le_card fun x hx ↦ ?_
        obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_add.1 hx
        exact Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨s(a, b), Finset.mk_mem_sym2_iff.2 ⟨ha, hb⟩, rfl⟩
    _ ≤ #A.sym2 := Finset.card_image_le

  have hf : f N ≤ (Nat.sqrt N + 1).choose 2 := by
    refine Finset.sup_le fun A hA ↦ ?_
    rw [← (Finset.mem_powersetCard.1 hA).2]
    exact (Finset.card_le_card Finset.inter_subset_left).trans (card_add_self_le A)
  have hsq : ((Nat.sqrt N : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sqrt_le' N
  have hle : ((Nat.sqrt N : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt N := Real.nat_sqrt_le_real_sqrt
  calc (f N : ℝ) ≤ ((Nat.sqrt N + 1).choose 2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hf
    _ = ((Nat.sqrt N : ℝ) ^ 2 + Nat.sqrt N) / 2 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_choose_two]; push_cast; ring
    _ ≤ (N + Real.sqrt N) / 2 := by linarith

    linarith

theorem erdos_644.variants.elementary_upper_bound (k r : ℕ) (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    Hypergraph.subfamilyTransversalBound k r 2 ≤ ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
  classical
  unfold Hypergraph.subfamilyTransversalBound
  refine iInf_le_of_le (2 * k) (iInf_le_of_le ?_ le_rfl)
  intro V F hu hl
  have hthree {e f g : Finset V} (he : e ∈ F) (hf : f ∈ F) (hg : g ∈ F)
      (hef : Disjoint e f) (heg : Disjoint e g) (hfg : Disjoint f g) : False := by
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hhit⟩ := hl {e, f, g} (by
      simpa only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.insert_subset_iff,
        Set.singleton_subset_iff] using And.intro he (And.intro hf hg))
      (Finset.card_le_three.trans hr)
    obtain ⟨x, hxS, hxe⟩ := hhit e (by simp)
    obtain ⟨y, hyS, hyf⟩ := hhit f (by simp)
    obtain ⟨z, hzS, hzg⟩ := hhit g (by simp)
    have hxy : x ≠ y := fun h ↦ Finset.disjoint_left.mp hef hxe (h.symm ▸ hyf)
    have hxz : x ≠ z := fun h ↦ Finset.disjoint_left.mp heg hxe (h.symm ▸ hzg)
    have hyz : y ≠ z := fun h ↦ Finset.disjoint_left.mp hfg hyf (h.symm ▸ hzg)
    have := Finset.card_le_card (show {x, y, z} ⊆ S by
      simpa only [Finset.insert_subset_iff, Finset.singleton_subset_iff] using
        And.intro hxS (And.intro hyS hzS))
    simp [hxy, hxz, hyz] at this
    omega
  by_cases hF : F.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hF
    by_cases hall : ∀ f ∈ F, ¬ Disjoint e f
    · refine ⟨e, by rw [hu e he]; omega, ?_⟩
      intro f hf
      simpa [Finset.not_disjoint_iff] using hall f hf
    · push Not at hall
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hef⟩ := hall
      refine ⟨e ∪ f, (Finset.card_union_le e f).trans (by rw [hu e he, hu f hf]; omega), ?_⟩
      intro g hg
      by_contra h
      have heg : Disjoint e g := Finset.disjoint_left.mpr (by
        intro x hxe hxg
        exact h ⟨x, Finset.mem_union_left f hxe, hxg⟩)
      have hfg : Disjoint f g := Finset.disjoint_left.mpr (by
        intro x hxf hxg
        exact h ⟨x, Finset.mem_union_right e hxf, hxg⟩)
      exact hthree he hf hg hef heg hfg
  · exact ⟨∅, by simp, fun e he ↦ (hF ⟨e, he⟩).elim⟩

    Hypergraph.subfamilyTransversalBound k r 2 < ⊤ :=

namespace Erdos808

def edgeValues {V R : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq R]
    (op : V → V → R) (hop : ∀ u v, op u v = op v u)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : Finset R :=
  G.edgeFinset.image (Sym2.lift ⟨op, hop⟩)

def edgeSums {V R : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq R] [AddCommMagma R]
    (a : V → R) (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : Finset R :=
  edgeValues (fun u v ↦ a u + a v) (fun u v ↦ add_comm (a u) (a v)) G

def edgeProducts {V R : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq R] [CommMagma R]
    (a : V → R) (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] : Finset R :=
  edgeValues (fun u v ↦ a u * a v) (fun u v ↦ mul_comm (a u) (a v)) G

theorem mem_edgeValues_iff {V R : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq R]
    (op : V → V → R) (hop : ∀ u v, op u v = op v u)
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : R) :
    r ∈ edgeValues op hop G ↔ ∃ u v, G.Adj u v ∧ r = op u v := by
  constructor
  · intro hr
    obtain ⟨e, he, her⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hr
    induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with
    | _ u v =>
        refine ⟨u, v, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa using he
        · simpa [Sym2.lift_mk] using her.symm
  · rintro ⟨u, v, huv, rfl⟩
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨s(u, v), ?_, by simp [Sym2.lift_mk]⟩
    simpa

theorem mem_edgeSums_iff {V R : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq R] [AddCommMagma R]
    (a : V → R) (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : R) :
    r ∈ edgeSums a G ↔ ∃ u v, G.Adj u v ∧ r = a u + a v :=
  mem_edgeValues_iff (fun u v ↦ a u + a v) (fun u v ↦ add_comm (a u) (a v)) G r

theorem mem_edgeProducts_iff {V R : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq R] [CommMagma R]
    (a : V → R) (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (r : R) :
    r ∈ edgeProducts a G ↔ ∃ u v, G.Adj u v ∧ r = a u * a v :=
  mem_edgeValues_iff (fun u v ↦ a u * a v) (fun u v ↦ mul_comm (a u) (a v)) G r

    ¬ ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →

  by_cases hfin : B.Finite
  by_cases hn : n = 0

  by_contra! h_abs
  exact ((hfin.offDiag.image _).subset hB.surjOn).not_infinite (by
    rw [show (0 : ZMod 0) = (0 : ℤ) from rfl]; exact (Set.finite_singleton (0 : ℤ)).infinite_compl)
  have : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

open Filter MeasureTheory Real Set

open scoped Topology

namespace Erdos5

noncomputable def normalizedGap (n : ℕ) : ℝ := primeGap n / log n

def limitPointSet : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | MapClusterPt x atTop normalizedGap}

theorem erdos_5.variants.hildebrand_maier : ∀ C : ℝ, ∃ x ∈ limitPointSet, C < x := by
  sorry

theorem mem_limitPointSet_iff (x : ℝ) : x ∈ limitPointSet ↔
    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono n ∧ Tendsto (fun i => normalizedGap (n i)) atTop (𝓝 x) :=
  ⟨fun hx => hx.tendsto_subseq, fun ⟨_n, hn, h⟩ => h.mapClusterPt.of_comp hn.tendsto_atTop⟩

theorem normalizedGap_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ normalizedGap n :=
  div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (log_natCast_nonneg _)

theorem limitPointSet_subset_Ici : limitPointSet ⊆ Ici 0 := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, -, h⟩ := (mem_limitPointSet_iff x).1 hx
  exact ge_of_tendsto' h fun i => normalizedGap_nonneg (n i)

theorem erdos_5_iff_limit_point_set :
    (∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → C ∈ limitPointSet) ↔ limitPointSet = Ici 0 :=
  ⟨fun h => limitPointSet_subset_Ici.antisymm h, fun h _ hC => h ▸ hC⟩

theorem isClosed_limitPointSet : IsClosed limitPointSet := isClosed_setOfPred_clusterPt

theorem dense_iff_limit_point_set :
    Ici (0 : ℝ) ⊆ closure limitPointSet ↔ limitPointSet = Ici 0 := by
  rw [isClosed_limitPointSet.closure_eq]
  exact ⟨fun h => limitPointSet_subset_Ici.antisymm h, fun h => h.ge⟩

-- See also Erdős Problem 234, which concerns the density of the integers `n` with

-- `(p (n + 1) - p n) / log n < c`.

end Erdos5

theorem erdos_707.variants.perfect_difference_set_size_bound (B : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ)
    (hB : IsPerfectDifferenceSet B n) : B.ncard ≤ n.sqrt + 1 := by
  by_cases hfin : B.Finite
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  subst hn; simp
  by_contra! h_abs
  exact ((hfin.offDiag.image _).subset hB.surjOn).not_infinite (by
    rw [show (0 : ZMod 0) = (0 : ℤ) from rfl]; exact (Set.finite_singleton (0 : ℤ)).infinite_compl)
  have : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩
  suffices h : (B.ncard - 1) ^ 2 ≤ n by have := Nat.le_sqrt'.mpr h; omega
  lift B to Finset ℕ using hfin; simp

    rwa [← Finset.coe_offDiag, ncard_coe_finset] at h_off_ncard_le

    rw [Finset.offDiag_card]; rcases B.card with _ | k <;> simp [Nat.succ_mul,
      Nat.mul_succ]
  have h_sq_le : (B.card - 1) ^ 2 ≤ B.card * (B.card - 1) := by
    rw [sq]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.sub_le _ _)

import Mathlib

open Filter Asymptotics Real

namespace Erdos17

def IsClusterPrime (p : ℕ) : Prop :=
  p.Prime ∧
    ∀ {n : ℕ}, Even n → n ≤ (p - 3 : ℤ) →
      ∃ q₁ q₂ : ℕ, q₁.Prime ∧ q₂.Prime ∧
        q₁ ≤ p ∧ q₂ ≤ p ∧ n = (q₁ - q₂ : ℤ)

noncomputable def clusterPrimeCount (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Nat.card {p : ℕ | p ≤ n ∧ IsClusterPrime p}

  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (1 / 8),
      IsBigOWith C atTop (fun x ↦ (clusterPrimeCount x : ℝ))
        (fun x ↦ x * exp (-c * (log (log x)) ^ 2)) := by
  sorry

theorem isClusterPrime_97_isLeast_non_cluster : IsLeast {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ ¬ IsClusterPrime p} 97 := by
  -- For a prime `p`, being a cluster prime is equivalent to a fully bounded
  -- (hence decidable) statement over `ℕ`: every even `n ≤ p - 3` is `q₁ - q₂`
  -- for primes `q₁, q₂ ≤ p`, which (since `n ≥ 0`) amounts to a prime `q₂ ≤ p`
  -- with `q₂ + n` again prime and `≤ p`.
  have cluster_iff : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
      (IsClusterPrime p ↔
        (∀ n ∈ Finset.range (p - 2), Even n →
          ∃ q₂ ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (Nat.Prime q₂) ∧ Nat.Prime (q₂ + n) ∧ q₂ + n ≤ p)) := by
    intro p hp
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, h⟩ n hn hev
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hn
      have hn3 : (n : ℤ) ≤ (p - 3 : ℤ) := by omega
      obtain ⟨q₁, q₂, hq1p, hq2p, hq1le, hq2le, heq⟩ := h hev hn3
      refine ⟨q₂, ?_, hq2p, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Finset.mem_range]; omega
      · have hq2n : q₂ + n = q₁ := by omega
        rw [hq2n]; exact hq1p
      · omega
    · intro h
      refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
      intro n hev hn3
      have hnp : n ≤ p - 3 := by omega
      have hnrange : n ∈ Finset.range (p - 2) := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_range]; omega
      obtain ⟨q₂, hq2r, hq2p, hq1p, hle⟩ := h n hnrange hev
      refine ⟨q₂ + n, q₂, hq1p, hq2p, hle, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hq2r; omega
      · push_cast; ring
  constructor
  · -- `97` is prime but not a cluster prime: the even number `88 ≤ 94` is not a
    -- difference of two primes `≤ 97`.
    refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    rw [cluster_iff 97 (by norm_num)]
    simp only [Nat.reduceSub, Finset.mem_range, Nat.reduceAdd, not_forall, not_exists, not_and,
      not_le]
    refine ⟨88, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_⟩
    intro x xl hx xl
    suffices 9 < x by
      lia
    contrapose! xl
    interval_cases x <;> norm_num
    · contrapose hx
      exact Nat.not_prime_one
    · contrapose hx
      norm_num
  · -- `97` is a lower bound: every prime `< 97` is a cluster prime, so cannot lie
    -- in the set of non-cluster primes.
    rintro b ⟨hbp, hbnc⟩
    by_contra! hlt
    interval_cases b <;>
      first
        | exact absurd hbp (by decide)
        | exact hbnc ((cluster_iff _ (by norm_num)).mpr (by set_option maxRecDepth 8000 in decide))

end Erdos17

import Mathlib

namespace Erdos482

noncomputable def a : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => ⌊√2 * ((a (n + 1) : ℝ) + 1 / 2)⌋₊

noncomputable def generalRecurrence (g : ℕ) (a b ε : ℝ) : ℕ → ℤ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 =>
      if Even n then ⌊a * ((generalRecurrence g a b ε n : ℝ) + ε)⌋
      else ⌊b * ((generalRecurrence g a b ε n : ℝ) + 1 / ((g : ℝ) - 1))⌋

noncomputable def alpha (t : ℝ) : ℝ := 2 * (t + 1) / (t + 2)

noncomputable def beta (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (t + 2) / (t + 1)

noncomputable def stollBinary (t : ℝ) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 =>
      ⌊(if Even n then alpha t else beta t) * ((stollBinary t n : ℝ) + 1 / 2)⌋₊

noncomputable def binaryDigit (t : ℝ) : ℕ → Fin 2
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | k + 2 => Real.digits (t - 1) 2 k

theorem erdos_482.variants.stoll_explicit (g : ℕ) (hg : 2 ≤ g) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (htg : t < g) (ε : ℝ)
    (hεlo : -1 / (g : ℝ) ≤ ε)
    (hεhi : ε < ((g : ℝ) + 1) * ((g : ℝ) - 2) / g) :
    let a := (g : ℝ) / (((g : ℝ) - 1) * (t + g))
    let b := ((g : ℝ) - 1) * (t + g)
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      generalRecurrence g a b ε (2 * n + 2) -
          (g : ℤ) * generalRecurrence g a b ε (2 * n) =
        ⌊t * (g : ℝ) ^ n⌋ - (g : ℤ) * ⌊t * (g : ℝ) ^ n / g⌋ := by
  sorry

end Erdos482

namespace Erdos709

def window (start length : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := Finset.Icc (start + 1) (start + length)

def HasDistinctMultiples (A : Finset ℕ) (start length : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ choice : ℕ → ℕ,
    Set.InjOn choice (A : Set ℕ) ∧
    ∀ a ∈ A, choice a ∈ window start length ∧ a ∣ choice a

def Works (n k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : Finset ℕ) (M : ℕ),
    A.card = n → M ∈ A → (∀ a ∈ A, a ≤ M) → (∀ a ∈ A, 2 ≤ a) →
    ∀ start : ℕ, HasDistinctMultiples A start (k * M)

def IsOptimal (n k : ℕ) : Prop := Works n k ∧ ∀ j < k, ¬ Works n j

theorem matching_mono_length
    (A : Finset ℕ) (start small large : ℕ) (hsmall : small ≤ large)
    (h : HasDistinctMultiples A start small) : HasDistinctMultiples A start large := by
  obtain ⟨choice, hinj, hchoice⟩ := h
  refine ⟨choice, hinj, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨hmem, hdvd⟩ := hchoice a ha
  refine ⟨?_, hdvd⟩
  simp only [window, Finset.mem_Icc] at hmem ⊢
  constructor
  · exact hmem.1
  · omega

theorem works_mono (n k l : ℕ) (hkl : k ≤ l) (h : Works n k) : Works n l := by
  intro A M hcard hmax hbound htwo start
  exact matching_mono_length A start (k * M) (l * M) (Nat.mul_le_mul_right M hkl)
    (h A M hcard hmax hbound htwo start)

theorem exists_multiple_in_window
    (a M start : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (haM : a ≤ M) :
    ∃ b ∈ window start M, a ∣ b := by
  let r := start % a
  let b := start + (a - r)
  have hr : r < a := Nat.mod_lt start ha
  have heq : start % a + a * (start / a) = start := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.mod_add_div start a
  have hbdiv : b = a * (start / a + 1) := by
    have haux : b = a * (start / a) + a := by
      dsimp [b, r]
      omega
    calc
      b = a * (start / a) + a := haux
      _ = a * (start / a + 1) := by ring
  refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [window, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · dsimp [b]
      omega
    · dsimp [b]
      omega
  · exact ⟨start / a + 1, hbdiv⟩

  intro A M hcard hM hbound htwo start

    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
    have hMz : M = z := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (hz ▸ hM)
    simpa [hMz] using hz
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hd⟩ :=
    exists_multiple_in_window M M start (by have := htwo M hM; omega) le_rfl
  refine ⟨fun _ => b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu v hv _
    rw [hA] at hu hv
    simp only [Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hu hv
    exact hu.trans hv.symm
  · intro a ha
    rw [hA] at ha
    have hEq : a = M := Finset.mem_singleton.mp ha
    subst a
    simpa using And.intro hb hd

  works_mono 1 1 k hk erdos_709.variants.singleton

  ∀ A : Finset ℕ, A.card = n → (∀ a ∈ A, 2 ≤ a) →

  obtain ⟨h3w, h3d⟩ := h 3 (by simp)

  have h23 : x 2 = x 3 := by omega

import Mathlib

open Filter Topology

namespace Erdos1000

def phiSeq (n : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((Finset.Icc 1 (n k)).filter fun m => ∀ j < k, ¬ (n k / Nat.gcd m (n k)) ∣ n j).card

noncomputable def phiAvg (n : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (phiSeq n k : ℝ) / (n k : ℝ)) / (N : ℝ)

theorem erdos_1000.variants.totient_le (n : ℕ → ℕ) (hn : StrictMono n) (hn0 : 0 < n 0)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (n k).totient ≤ phiSeq n k := by
  rw [Nat.totient, phiSeq]
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun a => if a = 0 then n k else a)
  · intro a ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at ha ⊢
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := ha
    have hgcd : Nat.gcd (if a = 0 then n k else a) (n k) = 1 := by
      by_cases h : a = 0
      · subst h
        have : n k = 1 := by simpa [Nat.coprime_zero_right] using ha2
        simp [this]
      · simp only [h, if_false]
        rw [Nat.gcd_comm]; exact ha2
    have hpos : 0 < n k := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le a) ha1
    have hmem : 1 ≤ (if a = 0 then n k else a) ∧ (if a = 0 then n k else a) ≤ n k := by
      by_cases h : a = 0
      · subst h
        rw [if_pos rfl]
        omega
      · rw [if_neg h]
        omega
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    rw [hgcd, Nat.div_one]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (hn0.trans_le (hn.monotone (Nat.zero_le j))) (hn hj)
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at ha hb
    simp only at hab
    by_cases h1 : a = 0 <;> by_cases h2 : b = 0
    · simp [h1, h2]
    · have : n k = 1 := by simpa [h1, Nat.coprime_zero_right] using ha.2
      omega
    · have : n k = 1 := by simpa [h2, Nat.coprime_zero_right] using hb.2
      omega
    · simpa [h1, h2] using hab

    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono n ∧ 0 < n 0 ∧

namespace Erdos509

open Polynomial

open scoped Real

section BoundedDiscCover

universe u v

variable {M : Type u} [MetricSpace M]

structure BoundedDiscCover (S : Set M) (r : ℝ) (ι : Type v) where
  (C : ι → M)
  (R : ι → ℝ)
  (h_cover : S ⊆ ⋃ (i : ι), Metric.closedBall (C i) (R i))
  (h_summable : Summable (fun i : ι => R i))
  (h_bdd : ∑' i, R i ≤ r)
  (h_pos : ∀ i, 0 < R i)

variable (S : Set M) (r : ℝ)

noncomputable def boundedDiscCover_empty [Nonempty M] (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
  (BoundedDiscCover (∅ : Set M) r (PUnit : Type v)) where
  C := fun _ => Classical.ofNonempty
  R := fun _ => r
  h_cover := Set.empty_subset _
  h_summable := (hasSum_fintype _).summable
  h_bdd := by
    have := hasSum_fintype fun (_ : (PUnit : Type v)) => if 0 ≤ r then -1 else r
    simp only [tsum_const, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_ofSubsingleton, one_smul,
      ge_iff_le]
    bound
  h_pos := by aesop

lemma BoundedDiscCover.bound_nonneg_of_nonempty
    (S : Set M) (hS : S.Nonempty) (r : ℝ) (ι : Type v)
    (bdc : BoundedDiscCover S r ι) :
    0 < r := by
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ bdc.h_bdd
  suffices Nonempty ι by
    apply Summable.tsum_pos bdc.h_summable (fun j => le_of_lt (bdc.h_pos j)) Classical.ofNonempty (bdc.h_pos _)
  by_contra!
  apply Set.Nonempty.ne_empty hS (Set.eq_empty_of_subset_empty _)
  convert bdc.h_cover
  aesop

end BoundedDiscCover

import Mathlib

open Filter Finset

open scoped Topology

namespace Erdos302

def NoUnitFractionTriple (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, ∀ c ∈ A, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c →
    (1 : ℚ) / a ≠ (1 : ℚ) / b + (1 : ℚ) / c

def IsMaxNoTripleCard (N m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  IsGreatest {k | ∃ A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N, NoUnitFractionTriple A ∧ A.card = k} m

theorem erdos_302.parts.ii (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ N, IsMaxNoTripleCard N (f N)) :
    ¬ Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (f N : ℝ) / N) atTop (𝓝 ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) := by
  sorry

theorem erdos_302.variants.lower_half (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ N, IsMaxNoTripleCard N (f N))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - ε) * N ≤ f N := by
  refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N => ?_
  set A : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range ((N + 1) / 2)).image (fun x => 2 * x + 1) with hA
  have hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    omega
  have hno : NoUnitFractionTriple A := by
    intro a ha b hb c hc _ _ _ h
    obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
    obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hb
    obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hc
    have hx : ((2 * x + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hy : ((2 * y + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hz : ((2 * z + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp at h
    have h' : (2 * y + 1) * (2 * z + 1) = (2 * x + 1) * (2 * z + 1 + (2 * y + 1)) := by
      exact_mod_cast h
    have := congrArg (· % 2) h'
    simp [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod] at this
  have hcard : A.card = (N + 1) / 2 := by
    rw [hA, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun x y hxy => by simpa using hxy),
      Finset.card_range]
  have hle : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ f N := by
    rw [← hcard]
    exact (hf N).2 ⟨A, hsub, hno, rfl⟩
  have h1 : (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((N + 1) / 2 : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : N ≤ 2 * ((N + 1) / 2))
  have h2 : (((N + 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ f N := by exact_mod_cast hle
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  nlinarith

end Erdos302

import Mathlib

open Filter Finset

open scoped Topology

namespace Erdos302

def NoUnitFractionTriple (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, ∀ c ∈ A, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c →
    (1 : ℚ) / a ≠ (1 : ℚ) / b + (1 : ℚ) / c

def IsMaxNoTripleCard (N m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  IsGreatest {k | ∃ A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N, NoUnitFractionTriple A ∧ A.card = k} m

theorem erdos_302.variants.lower_half (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ N, IsMaxNoTripleCard N (f N))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - ε) * N ≤ f N := by
  refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N => ?_
  set A : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range ((N + 1) / 2)).image (fun x => 2 * x + 1) with hA
  have hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    omega
  have hno : NoUnitFractionTriple A := by
    intro a ha b hb c hc _ _ _ h
    obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
    obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hb
    obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hc
    have hx : ((2 * x + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hy : ((2 * y + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hz : ((2 * z + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp at h
    have h' : (2 * y + 1) * (2 * z + 1) = (2 * x + 1) * (2 * z + 1 + (2 * y + 1)) := by
      exact_mod_cast h
    have := congrArg (· % 2) h'
    simp [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod] at this
  have hcard : A.card = (N + 1) / 2 := by
    rw [hA, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun x y hxy => by simpa using hxy),
      Finset.card_range]
  have hle : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ f N := by
    rw [← hcard]
    exact (hf N).2 ⟨A, hsub, hno, rfl⟩
  have h1 : (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((N + 1) / 2 : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : N ≤ 2 * ((N + 1) / 2))
  have h2 : (((N + 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ f N := by exact_mod_cast hle
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  nlinarith

import Mathlib

namespace Erdos509

open Polynomial

open scoped Real

section BoundedDiscCover

universe u v

variable {M : Type u} [MetricSpace M]

structure BoundedDiscCover (S : Set M) (r : ℝ) (ι : Type v) where
  (C : ι → M)
  (R : ι → ℝ)
  (h_cover : S ⊆ ⋃ (i : ι), Metric.closedBall (C i) (R i))
  (h_summable : Summable (fun i : ι => R i))
  (h_bdd : ∑' i, R i ≤ r)
  (h_pos : ∀ i, 0 < R i)

variable (S : Set M) (r : ℝ)

noncomputable def boundedDiscCover_empty [Nonempty M] (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
  (BoundedDiscCover (∅ : Set M) r (PUnit : Type v)) where
  C := fun _ => Classical.ofNonempty
  R := fun _ => r
  h_cover := Set.empty_subset _
  h_summable := (hasSum_fintype _).summable
  h_bdd := by
    have := hasSum_fintype fun (_ : (PUnit : Type v)) => if 0 ≤ r then -1 else r
    simp only [tsum_const, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_ofSubsingleton, one_smul,
      ge_iff_le]
    bound
  h_pos := by aesop

lemma BoundedDiscCover.bound_nonneg_of_nonempty
    (S : Set M) (hS : S.Nonempty) (r : ℝ) (ι : Type v)
    (bdc : BoundedDiscCover S r ι) :
    0 < r := by
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ bdc.h_bdd
  suffices Nonempty ι by
    apply Summable.tsum_pos bdc.h_summable (fun j => le_of_lt (bdc.h_pos j)) Classical.ofNonempty (bdc.h_pos _)
  by_contra!
  apply Set.Nonempty.ne_empty hS (Set.eq_empty_of_subset_empty _)
  convert bdc.h_cover
  aesop

end BoundedDiscCover

structure EFLConfig (V : Type*) (n : ℕ) where

  A : Fin n → Finset V

variable {V : Type*} {n : ℕ} (C : EFLConfig V n)

def graph : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj u v := u ≠ v ∧ ∃ i, u ∈ C.A i ∧ v ∈ C.A i

  loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩

  ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).biUnion C.A).filter C.IsShared

theorem le_chromaticNumber : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ C.graph.chromaticNumber := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp
  have hcl : C.graph.IsClique (C.A ⟨0, hn⟩ : Set V) := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    exact ⟨huv, ⟨0, hn⟩, hu, hv⟩
  have := hcl.card_le_chromaticNumber
  rwa [C.card_eq] at this

lemma eq_of_not_shared {v : V} (hv : ¬ C.IsShared v) {i j : Fin n}
    (hi : v ∈ C.A i) (hj : v ∈ C.A j) : i = j := by
  by_contra h
  exact hv ⟨i, j, h, hi, hj⟩

open scoped Classical in
theorem colorable_of_sharedColoring (c : V → Fin n)
    (hc : ∀ i u v, u ∈ C.A i → v ∈ C.A i → C.IsShared u → C.IsShared v → c u = c v → u = v) :
    C.graph.Colorable n := by
  -- private vertices and free colours of each clique
  let P : Fin n → Finset V := fun i => (C.A i).filter (fun v => ¬ C.IsShared v)
  let U : Fin n → Finset V := fun i => (C.A i).filter C.IsShared
  let F : Fin n → Finset (Fin n) := fun i => Finset.univ \ (U i).image c
  have hcard : ∀ i, (P i).card ≤ (F i).card := by
    intro i
    have h1 : (U i).card + (P i).card = n := by
      rw [← C.card_eq i]; exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
    have h2 : ((U i).image c).card ≤ (U i).card := Finset.card_image_le
    have h3 : (F i).card = n - ((U i).image c).card := by
      simp [F, Finset.card_sdiff]
    omega
  have hne : ∀ i, Nonempty (P i ↪ F i) := fun i =>
    Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (by simpa using hcard i)
  let e : ∀ i, P i ↪ F i := fun i => Classical.choice (hne i)
  let idx : V → Fin n := fun v => Classical.choose (C.cover v)
  have hidx : ∀ v, v ∈ C.A (idx v) := fun v => Classical.choose_spec (C.cover v)
  let col : V → Fin n := fun v =>
    if h : C.IsShared v then c v
    else ((e (idx v) ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hidx v, h⟩⟩ : F (idx v)) : Fin n)
  have col_priv : ∀ v (hv : ¬ C.IsShared v) j (hj : v ∈ C.A j),
      col v = ((e j ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, hv⟩⟩ : F j) : Fin n) := by
    intro v hv j hj
    have key : ∀ i (hi : i = j) (p : v ∈ P i), ((e i ⟨v, p⟩ : F i) : Fin n) =
        ((e j ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, hv⟩⟩ : F j) : Fin n) := by
      rintro i rfl p; rfl
    simp only [col, dif_neg hv]
    exact key _ (C.eq_of_not_shared hv (hidx v) hj) _
  have col_free : ∀ v (hv : ¬ C.IsShared v) j (hj : v ∈ C.A j), col v ∈ F j := by
    intro v hv j hj
    rw [col_priv v hv j hj]; exact Subtype.property _
  refine ⟨SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk col ?_⟩
  rintro u v ⟨huv, j, hu, hv⟩ heq
  by_cases su : C.IsShared u <;> by_cases sv : C.IsShared v
  · have : col u = c u := dif_pos su
    have : col v = c v := dif_pos sv
    exact huv (hc j u v hu hv su sv (by simp_all))
  · have h1 := col_free v sv j hv
    have : col u = c u := dif_pos su
    simp only [F, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image] at h1
    exact h1 ⟨u, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hu, su⟩, by rw [← this, heq]⟩
  · have h1 := col_free u su j hu
    have : col v = c v := dif_pos sv
    simp only [F, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image] at h1
    exact h1 ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hv, sv⟩, by rw [← this, ← heq]⟩
  · rw [col_priv u su j hu, col_priv v sv j hv] at heq
    have := (e j).injective (Subtype.ext heq)
    exact huv (congrArg Subtype.val this)

open scoped Classical in
theorem card_sharedSet_le : C.sharedSet.card ≤ n.choose 2 := by
  -- assign to each shared vertex a pair of cliques containing it
  let f : V → Finset (Fin n) := fun v =>
    if h : C.IsShared v then {Classical.choose h, Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec h)}
    else ∅
  have hf : ∀ v ∈ C.sharedSet, f v ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard 2 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ f v, v ∈ C.A x := by
    intro v hv
    have hs : C.IsShared v := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hv).2
    obtain ⟨hij, hi, hj⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec hs)
    simp only [f, dif_pos hs]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, Finset.card_pair hij⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hi
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 hx]; exact hj
  have hinj : Set.InjOn f C.sharedSet := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    obtain ⟨hpu, hu'⟩ := hf u hu
    obtain ⟨hpv, hv'⟩ := hf v hv
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hfab⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 (Finset.mem_powersetCard.1 hpu).2
    have ha : a ∈ f u := by rw [hfab]; simp
    have hb : b ∈ f u := by rw [hfab]; simp
    have hle := C.inter_le a b hab
    have hu2 : u ∈ C.A a ∩ C.A b := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨hu' a ha, hu' b hb⟩
    have hv2 : v ∈ C.A a ∩ C.A b :=
      Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨hv' a (huv ▸ ha), hv' b (huv ▸ hb)⟩
    exact Finset.card_le_one.1 hle u hu2 v hv2
  have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn f (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard 2)
    (fun v hv => (hf v hv).1) hinj
  simpa [Finset.card_powersetCard] using this

end EFLConfig

open EFLConfig

open scoped Classical in
theorem erdos_19.variants.le_three {V : Type*} {n : ℕ} (C : EFLConfig V n) (hn : n ≤ 3) :
    C.graph.chromaticNumber = n := by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ C.le_chromaticNumber
  apply SimpleGraph.Colorable.chromaticNumber_le
  have hS : C.sharedSet.card ≤ n := by
    have h1 := C.card_sharedSet_le
    have h2 : n.choose 2 ≤ n := by interval_cases n <;> decide
    omega
  -- colour the shared vertices injectively
  let c : V → Fin n := fun v =>
    if h : v ∈ C.sharedSet then Fin.castLE hS (C.sharedSet.equivFin ⟨v, h⟩)
    else ⟨0, by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := C.cover v
      rw [← C.card_eq i]; exact Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨v, hi⟩⟩
  refine C.colorable_of_sharedColoring c ?_
  intro i u v hu hv su sv huv
  have mu : u ∈ C.sharedSet := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, by simp, hu⟩, su⟩
  have mv : v ∈ C.sharedSet := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, by simp, hv⟩, sv⟩
  simp only [c, dif_pos mu, dif_pos mv] at huv
  have := C.sharedSet.equivFin.injective (Fin.castLE_injective hS huv)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

theorem erdos_19.variants.large_n :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ (V : Type) (C : EFLConfig V n), C.graph.chromaticNumber = n := by
  sorry

end Erdos19

import Mathlib

open Filter Finset

open scoped Topology

namespace Erdos302

def NoUnitFractionTriple (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, ∀ c ∈ A, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → b ≠ c →
    (1 : ℚ) / a ≠ (1 : ℚ) / b + (1 : ℚ) / c

def IsMaxNoTripleCard (N m : ℕ) : Prop :=
  IsGreatest {k | ∃ A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N, NoUnitFractionTriple A ∧ A.card = k} m

theorem erdos_302.variants.lower_half (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ N, IsMaxNoTripleCard N (f N))
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - ε) * N ≤ f N := by
  refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N => ?_
  set A : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range ((N + 1) / 2)).image (fun x => 2 * x + 1) with hA
  have hsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hx
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    omega
  have hno : NoUnitFractionTriple A := by
    intro a ha b hb c hc _ _ _ h
    obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
    obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hb
    obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hc
    have hx : ((2 * x + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hy : ((2 * y + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hz : ((2 * z + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp at h
    have h' : (2 * y + 1) * (2 * z + 1) = (2 * x + 1) * (2 * z + 1 + (2 * y + 1)) := by
      exact_mod_cast h
    have := congrArg (· % 2) h'
    simp [Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod] at this
  have hcard : A.card = (N + 1) / 2 := by
    rw [hA, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun x y hxy => by simpa using hxy),
      Finset.card_range]
  have hle : (N + 1) / 2 ≤ f N := by
    rw [← hcard]
    exact (hf N).2 ⟨A, hsub, hno, rfl⟩
  have h1 : (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ((N + 1) / 2 : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : N ≤ 2 * ((N + 1) / 2))
  have h2 : (((N + 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ f N := by exact_mod_cast hle
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  nlinarith

    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :

  sorry

end Erdos302

import Mathlib

open Filter

open scoped Finset

namespace Erdos864

def sumRepresentations (A : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  {p ∈ A ×ˢ A | p.1 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.1 + p.2 = n}

def HasAtMostOneRepeatedSum (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ n m : ℕ, 1 < #(sumRepresentations A n) → 1 < #(sumRepresentations A m) → n = m

theorem erdos_864.variants.lower_bound :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∃ A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N,
      HasAtMostOneRepeatedSum A ∧
        (1 - ε) * (2 / Real.sqrt 3) * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) ≤ #A := by
  sorry

theorem hasAtMostOneRepeatedSum_of_isSidon {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : IsSidon (A : Set ℕ)) :
    HasAtMostOneRepeatedSum A := by
  intro n m hn _
  exfalso
  obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 hn
  simp only [sumRepresentations, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp hq
  obtain ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hp3, hp4⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨⟨hq1, hq2⟩, hq3, hq4⟩ := hq
  rcases hA p.1 (Finset.mem_coe.2 hp1) q.1 (Finset.mem_coe.2 hq1)
      p.2 (Finset.mem_coe.2 hp2) q.2 (Finset.mem_coe.2 hq2) (by omega) with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact hpq (Prod.ext h1 h2)
  · exact hpq (Prod.ext (by omega) (by omega))

theorem hasAtMostOneRepeatedSum_one_two_three : HasAtMostOneRepeatedSum {1, 2, 3} := by
  have key : ∀ n, 1 < #(sumRepresentations {1, 2, 3} n) → n = 4 := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hp, ⟨c, d⟩, hq, hpq⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 hn
    simp only [sumRepresentations, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_insert,
      Finset.mem_singleton] at hp hq
    have hne : a ≠ c ∨ b ≠ d := by
      rw [Ne, Prod.mk.injEq, not_and_or] at hpq
      exact hpq
    omega
  intro n m hn hm
  rw [key n hn, key m hm]

theorem not_hasAtMostOneRepeatedSum_Icc_one_four :
    ¬ HasAtMostOneRepeatedSum (Finset.Icc 1 4) := by
  intro h
  have h4 : 1 < #(sumRepresentations (Finset.Icc 1 4) 4) := by decide +kernel
  have h5 : 1 < #(sumRepresentations (Finset.Icc 1 4) 5) := by decide +kernel
  have := h 4 5 h4 h5
  omega

end Erdos864

def Covers {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ k ≤ n, position X k ω = x

def closedDisc (r : ℕ) : Set (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  {x : ℤ × ℤ | x.1 ^ 2 + x.2 ^ 2 ≤ (r : ℤ) ^ 2}

def openDisc (r : ℕ) : Set (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  {x : ℤ × ℤ | x.1 ^ 2 + x.2 ^ 2 < (r : ℤ) ^ 2}

noncomputable def coveringRadius {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℕ :=
  sSup {r : ℕ | Covers X n ω (closedDisc r)}

theorem covers_closedDisc_zero {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    Covers X n ω (closedDisc 0) := by
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x.1 ^ 2 + x.2 ^ 2 ≤ ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ^ 2 := hx
  rw [Nat.cast_zero] at hx'
  have h1 : x.1 ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x.1, sq_nonneg x.2]

  refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le n, ?_⟩
  rw [position_zero]
  exact Prod.ext ((pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).1 h1).symm

namespace Erdos654

theorem erdos_654.variants.trivial_bound (A : Finset ℝ²) (hA : NoFourConcyclic A) :
    ∀ x ∈ A, ((#A : ℝ) - 1) / 3 ≤ (distinctDistancesFrom A x : ℝ) := by
  intro x hx
  have hfib : ∀ d ∈ (A.erase x).image (fun y ↦ dist y x),
      #{y ∈ A.erase x | dist y x = d} ≤ 3 := by
    intro d _
    by_contra! h4
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hT4⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_card_eq h4
    refine hA (T : Set ℝ²) (fun y hy ↦ ?_) (by rw [Set.ncard_coe_finset, hT4])
      ⟨x, d, fun y hy ↦ (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hT (Finset.mem_coe.1 hy))).2⟩
    exact Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_filter.1 (hT (Finset.mem_coe.1 hy))).1
  have hle := Finset.card_le_mul_card_image (A.erase x) 3 hfib
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hx] at hle
  have h1 : 1 ≤ #A := Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hle' : #A - 1 ≤ 3 * distinctDistancesFrom A x := by
    unfold distinctDistancesFrom
    convert hle using 3
    ext d
    simp
  have : ((#A - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (distinctDistancesFrom A x : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hle'
  rw [Nat.cast_sub h1, Nat.cast_one] at this
  linarith

open Polynomial

section BoundedDiscCover

universe u v

variable {M : Type u} [MetricSpace M]

structure BoundedDiscCover (S : Set M) (r : ℝ) (ι : Type v) where
  (C : ι → M)
  (R : ι → ℝ)
  (h_cover : S ⊆ ⋃ (i : ι), Metric.closedBall (C i) (R i))
  (h_summable : Summable (fun i : ι => R i))
  (h_bdd : ∑' i, R i ≤ r)
  (h_pos : ∀ i, 0 < R i)

variable (S : Set M) (r : ℝ)

noncomputable def boundedDiscCover_empty [Nonempty M] (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
  (BoundedDiscCover (∅ : Set M) r (PUnit : Type v)) where
  C := fun _ => Classical.ofNonempty
  R := fun _ => r
  h_cover := Set.empty_subset _
  h_summable := (hasSum_fintype _).summable
  h_bdd := by
    have := hasSum_fintype fun (_ : (PUnit : Type v)) => if 0 ≤ r then -1 else r
    simp only [tsum_const, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_ofSubsingleton, one_smul,
      ge_iff_le]

def HasPropertyS {V : Type*} (G : Digraph V) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ E : Finset V, E.card = n → ∃ x ∉ E, ∀ e ∈ E, G.Adj x e

noncomputable def f (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {m : ℕ | n ≤ m ∧ ∃ G : Digraph (Fin m), G.IsTournament ∧ HasPropertyS G n}

theorem f_one_le : f 1 ≤ 3 := by
  refine Nat.sInf_le ⟨by norm_num, ⟨fun a b => b = a + 1⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide⟩, ?_⟩
  intro E hE
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1 hE
  have key : ∀ a : Fin 3, a + 2 ≠ a ∧ a = a + 2 + 1 := by decide
  refine ⟨a + 2, by simp [(key a).1], fun e he => ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 he]
  exact (key a).2

theorem f_two_le : f 2 ≤ 7 := by
  refine Nat.sInf_le ⟨by norm_num, ⟨fun a b => b - a ∈ ({1, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 7))⟩,
    ⟨by decide, by decide⟩, ?_⟩
  intro E hE
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 hE
  have key : ∀ a b : Fin 7, a ≠ b → ∃ x, x ≠ a ∧ x ≠ b ∧
      a - x ∈ ({1, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 7)) ∧ b - x ∈ ({1, 2, 4} : Finset (Fin 7)) := by
    decide
  obtain ⟨x, hxa, hxb, ha, hb⟩ := key a b hab
  refine ⟨x, by simp [hxa, hxb], fun e he => ?_⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 he with rfl | he
  · exact ha
  · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 he]
    exact hb

theorem erdos_902.variants.f_one : f 1 = 3 := by
  refine le_antisymm f_one_le (le_csInf ⟨3, ?_⟩ ?_)
  · refine ⟨by norm_num, ⟨fun a b => b = a + 1⟩, ⟨by decide, by decide⟩, ?_⟩
    intro E hE
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1 hE
    have key : ∀ a : Fin 3, a + 2 ≠ a ∧ a = a + 2 + 1 := by decide
    refine ⟨a + 2, by simp [(key a).1], fun e he => ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 he]
    exact (key a).2
  · rintro m ⟨hm, G, hG, hS⟩
    by_contra! hm3
    interval_cases m
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := hS {0} rfl
      exact hx (by simp [Subsingleton.elim x 0])
    · have h01 := hG.2 0 1 (by decide)
      by_cases h : G.Adj 0 1
      · obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := hS {0} rfl
        have hx1 : x = 1 := by fin_cases x <;> simp_all
        subst hx1
        exact h01.1 h (hx0 0 (by simp))
      · obtain ⟨x, hx, hx1⟩ := hS {1} rfl
        have hx0 : x = 0 := by fin_cases x <;> simp_all
        subst hx0
        exact h (hx1 1 (by simp))

theorem erdos_902.variants.szekeres_lower :
    ∃ c > (0 : ℝ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c * n * 2 ^ n ≤ (f n : ℝ) := by

end Erdos902

noncomputable def normalizedGap (n : ℕ) : ℝ := primeGap n / log n

  ⟨fun hx => hx.tendsto_subseq, fun ⟨_n, hn, h⟩ => h.mapClusterPt.of_comp hn.tendsto_atTop⟩

  exact ⟨fun h => limitPointSet_subset_Ici.antisymm h, fun h => h.ge⟩

entries.statement: : ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ (V : Type) (C : EFLConfig V n), C.graph.Colorable ⌊(1 + ε) * n⌋₊
entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

open Filter

namespace Erdos19

open scoped Classical in
structure EFLConfig (V : Type*) (n : ℕ) where

  A : Fin n → Finset V

  card_eq : ∀ i, (A i).card = n

  inter_le : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (A i ∩ A j).card ≤ 1

  cover : ∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ A i

namespace EFLConfig

variable {V : Type*} {n : ℕ} (C : EFLConfig V n)

def graph : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj u v := u ≠ v ∧ ∃ i, u ∈ C.A i ∧ v ∈ C.A i
  symm := ⟨fun _ _ ⟨h, i, hu, hv⟩ => ⟨h.symm, i, hv, hu⟩⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩

def IsShared (v : V) : Prop := ∃ i j, i ≠ j ∧ v ∈ C.A i ∧ v ∈ C.A j

open scoped Classical in
noncomputable def sharedSet : Finset V :=
  ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).biUnion C.A).filter C.IsShared

theorem le_chromaticNumber : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ C.graph.chromaticNumber := by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp
  have hcl : C.graph.IsClique (C.A ⟨0, hn⟩ : Set V) := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    exact ⟨huv, ⟨0, hn⟩, hu, hv⟩
  have := hcl.card_le_chromaticNumber
  rwa [C.card_eq] at this

lemma eq_of_not_shared {v : V} (hv : ¬ C.IsShared v) {i j : Fin n}
    (hi : v ∈ C.A i) (hj : v ∈ C.A j) : i = j := by
  by_contra h
  exact hv ⟨i, j, h, hi, hj⟩

open scoped Classical in
theorem colorable_of_sharedColoring (c : V → Fin n)
    (hc : ∀ i u v, u ∈ C.A i → v ∈ C.A i → C.IsShared u → C.IsShared v → c u = c v → u = v) :
    C.graph.Colorable n := by
  -- private vertices and free colours of each clique
  let P : Fin n → Finset V := fun i => (C.A i).filter (fun v => ¬ C.IsShared v)
  let U : Fin n → Finset V := fun i => (C.A i).filter C.IsShared
  let F : Fin n → Finset (Fin n) := fun i => Finset.univ \ (U i).image c
  have hcard : ∀ i, (P i).card ≤ (F i).card := by
    intro i
    have h1 : (U i).card + (P i).card = n := by
      rw [← C.card_eq i]; exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not _
    have h2 : ((U i).image c).card ≤ (U i).card := Finset.card_image_le
    have h3 : (F i).card = n - ((U i).image c).card := by
      simp [F, Finset.card_sdiff]
    omega
  have hne : ∀ i, Nonempty (P i ↪ F i) := fun i =>
    Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (by simpa using hcard i)
  let e : ∀ i, P i ↪ F i := fun i => Classical.choice (hne i)
  let idx : V → Fin n := fun v => Classical.choose (C.cover v)
  have hidx : ∀ v, v ∈ C.A (idx v) := fun v => Classical.choose_spec (C.cover v)
  let col : V → Fin n := fun v =>
    if h : C.IsShared v then c v
    else ((e (idx v) ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hidx v, h⟩⟩ : F (idx v)) : Fin n)
  have col_priv : ∀ v (hv : ¬ C.IsShared v) j (hj : v ∈ C.A j),
      col v = ((e j ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, hv⟩⟩ : F j) : Fin n) := by
    intro v hv j hj
    have key : ∀ i (hi : i = j) (p : v ∈ P i), ((e i ⟨v, p⟩ : F i) : Fin n) =
        ((e j ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hj, hv⟩⟩ : F j) : Fin n) := by
      rintro i rfl p; rfl
    simp only [col, dif_neg hv]
    exact key _ (C.eq_of_not_shared hv (hidx v) hj) _
  have col_free : ∀ v (hv : ¬ C.IsShared v) j (hj : v ∈ C.A j), col v ∈ F j := by
    intro v hv j hj
    rw [col_priv v hv j hj]; exact Subtype.property _
  refine ⟨SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk col ?_⟩
  rintro u v ⟨huv, j, hu, hv⟩ heq
  by_cases su : C.IsShared u <;> by_cases sv : C.IsShared v
  · have : col u = c u := dif_pos su
    have : col v = c v := dif_pos sv
    exact huv (hc j u v hu hv su sv (by simp_all))
  · have h1 := col_free v sv j hv
    have : col u = c u := dif_pos su
    simp only [F, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image] at h1
    exact h1 ⟨u, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hu, su⟩, by rw [← this, heq]⟩
  · have h1 := col_free u su j hu
    have : col v = c v := dif_pos sv
    simp only [F, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image] at h1
    exact h1 ⟨v, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hv, sv⟩, by rw [← this, ← heq]⟩
  · rw [col_priv u su j hu, col_priv v sv j hv] at heq
    have := (e j).injective (Subtype.ext heq)
    exact huv (congrArg Subtype.val this)

open scoped Classical in
theorem card_sharedSet_le : C.sharedSet.card ≤ n.choose 2 := by
  -- assign to each shared vertex a pair of cliques containing it
  let f : V → Finset (Fin n) := fun v =>
    if h : C.IsShared v then {Classical.choose h, Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec h)}
    else ∅
  have hf : ∀ v ∈ C.sharedSet, f v ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard 2 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ f v, v ∈ C.A x := by
    intro v hv
    have hs : C.IsShared v := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hv).2
    obtain ⟨hij, hi, hj⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec hs)
    simp only [f, dif_pos hs]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, Finset.card_pair hij⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hi
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 hx]; exact hj
  have hinj : Set.InjOn f C.sharedSet := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    obtain ⟨hpu, hu'⟩ := hf u hu
    obtain ⟨hpv, hv'⟩ := hf v hv
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hfab⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 (Finset.mem_powersetCard.1 hpu).2
    have ha : a ∈ f u := by rw [hfab]; simp
    have hb : b ∈ f u := by rw [hfab]; simp
    have hle := C.inter_le a b hab
    have hu2 : u ∈ C.A a ∩ C.A b := Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨hu' a ha, hu' b hb⟩
    have hv2 : v ∈ C.A a ∩ C.A b :=
      Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨hv' a (huv ▸ ha), hv' b (huv ▸ hb)⟩
    exact Finset.card_le_one.1 hle u hu2 v hv2
  have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn f (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard 2)
    (fun v hv => (hf v hv).1) hinj
  simpa [Finset.card_powersetCard] using this

end EFLConfig

open EFLConfig

open scoped Classical in
theorem erdos_19.variants.le_three {V : Type*} {n : ℕ} (C : EFLConfig V n) (hn : n ≤ 3) :
    C.graph.chromaticNumber = n := by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ C.le_chromaticNumber
  apply SimpleGraph.Colorable.chromaticNumber_le
  have hS : C.sharedSet.card ≤ n := by
    have h1 := C.card_sharedSet_le
    have h2 : n.choose 2 ≤ n := by interval_cases n <;> decide
    omega
  -- colour the shared vertices injectively
  let c : V → Fin n := fun v =>
    if h : v ∈ C.sharedSet then Fin.castLE hS (C.sharedSet.equivFin ⟨v, h⟩)
    else ⟨0, by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := C.cover v
      rw [← C.card_eq i]; exact Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨v, hi⟩⟩
  refine C.colorable_of_sharedColoring c ?_
  intro i u v hu hv su sv huv
  have mu : u ∈ C.sharedSet := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, by simp, hu⟩, su⟩
  have mv : v ∈ C.sharedSet := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, by simp, hv⟩, sv⟩
  simp only [c, dif_pos mu, dif_pos mv] at huv
  have := C.sharedSet.equivFin.injective (Fin.castLE_injective hS huv)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

theorem erdos_19.variants.kahn :
    ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ (V : Type) (C : EFLConfig V n),
      C.graph.Colorable ⌊(1 + ε) * n⌋₊ := by
  sorry

end Erdos19

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

open scoped Topology

namespace Erdos170

@[reducible]
def PerfectRuler (N : ℕ) (A : Finset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ∃ᵉ (a₀ ∈ A) (a₁ ∈ A), k = a₁ - a₀

def PerfectRulersLengthN (N : ℕ) :
    Finset (Finset ℕ) := (Finset.range (N + 1)).powerset.filter (PerfectRuler N)

abbrev TrivialRuler (N : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := Finset.range (N+1)

lemma trivial_ruler_is_perfect (N : ℕ) : TrivialRuler N ∈ PerfectRulersLengthN N := by
    simp only [PerfectRulersLengthN, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset, Finset.range_subset]
    exact ⟨by simp, fun k hk => ⟨0, by simp, k, hk, rfl⟩⟩

def F (N : ℕ) : ℕ :=
    Finset.min' (Finset.image Finset.card (PerfectRulersLengthN N))
                (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr ⟨TrivialRuler N, trivial_ruler_is_perfect N⟩)

noncomputable abbrev lower_bound := √(sSup {2 * (1 - Real.sin θ / θ) | θ ≠ 0})

noncomputable abbrev upper_bound := √3

theorem erdos170.existing_bounds :
  ∃ x ∈ Set.Icc lower_bound upper_bound,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N => F N / √N) Filter.atTop (𝓝 x) := by
  sorry

end Erdos170

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

open Nat Filter

open scoped Topology Asymptotics

namespace Erdos456

noncomputable def p (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf { k | k.Prime ∧ k ≡ 1 [MOD n] }

noncomputable def m (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf { k | 0 < k ∧ n ∣ totient k }

theorem erdos_456.variants.linniks_theorem :
    ∃ L : ℝ, (fun n ↦ (p n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ L) := by
  sorry

theorem erdos_456.variants.mn_leq_pn (n : ℕ) :
    m n ≤ p n := by
  unfold m p
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with hn | hn
  · subst hn
    have hempty : {k | 0 < k ∧ (0 : ℕ) ∣ totient k} = (∅ : Set ℕ) := by
      ext k
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
      intro hk
      rw [zero_dvd_iff]
      have := Nat.totient_pos.mpr hk
      omega
    rw [hempty, Nat.sInf_empty]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  · have hne : {k | k.Prime ∧ k ≡ 1 [MOD n]}.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨q, _, hq, hmod⟩ :=
        Nat.forall_exists_prime_gt_and_modEq 0 hn (Nat.coprime_one_left n)
      exact ⟨q, hq, hmod⟩
    obtain ⟨hp, hmod⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
    apply Nat.sInf_le
    refine ⟨hp.pos, ?_⟩
    rw [Nat.totient_prime hp]
    exact (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hp.pos).mp hmod.symm

theorem erdos_456.variants.infinitely_many_n :
    { n | m n < p n }.Infinite := by
  apply Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (f := fun j : ℕ ↦ 2 ^ (2 * j + 3))
  · intro a b hab
    apply Nat.pow_right_injective (by decide) at hab
    omega
  · intro j
    let k := 2 * j + 3
    -- Witness n = 2^k for odd k ≥ 3; then m(n) ≤ 2n, while 3 ∣ n + 1 forces p(n) > 2n.
    change m (2 ^ k) < p (2 ^ k)
    have hm : m (2 ^ k) ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) := by
      unfold m
      refine Nat.sInf_le ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [Nat.totient_prime_pow Nat.prime_two (by omega)]
      norm_num
    have hp : 2 ^ (k + 1) + 1 ≤ p (2 ^ k) := by
      unfold p
      let q := sInf {x | x.Prime ∧ x ≡ 1 [MOD 2 ^ k]}
      change 2 ^ (k + 1) + 1 ≤ q
      have hne : {x | x.Prime ∧ x ≡ 1 [MOD 2 ^ k]}.Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨r, _, hr, hmod⟩ := Nat.forall_exists_prime_gt_and_modEq 0
          (pow_ne_zero k (by decide)) (Nat.coprime_one_left (2 ^ k))
        exact ⟨r, hr, hmod⟩
      obtain ⟨hprime, hmod⟩ : q.Prime ∧ q ≡ 1 [MOD 2 ^ k] := Nat.sInf_mem hne
      rw [Nat.pow_succ]
      by_contra hbound
      have hxle : q ≤ 2 ^ k * 2 := by omega
      have hlower : 2 ^ k + 1 ≤ q := by
        simpa [add_comm] using hmod.symm.add_le_of_lt hprime.one_lt
      have hupper : q ≤ 2 ^ k + 1 :=
        (hmod.trans Nat.add_modEq_left.symm).le_of_lt_add (by omega)
      have hxeq : q = 2 ^ k + 1 := by omega
      have hkodd : Odd k := ⟨j + 1, by dsimp [k]; omega⟩
      have hxeqthree : q = 3 := (hprime.dvd_iff_eq (by decide)).mp (by
        rw [hxeq]
        simpa using hkodd.nat_add_dvd_pow_add_pow 2 1)
      have heighteen : 8 ≤ 2 ^ k := by
        change 2 ^ 3 ≤ 2 ^ k
        exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by dsimp [k]; omega)
      omega
    omega

end Erdos456

import Mathlib

open Filter

open scoped EuclideanGeometry

namespace Erdos651

def IsInGeneralPosition {k : ℕ} (X : Finset (ℝ^k)) : Prop :=
  ∀ Y ⊆ X, Y.card ≤ k + 1 → AffineIndependent ℝ ((↑) : ↥(Y : Set (ℝ^k)) → ℝ^k)

def HasConvexSubset {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (X : Finset (ℝ^k)) : Prop :=
  ∃ Y ⊆ X, Y.card = n ∧ ConvexIndependent ℝ ((↑) : ↥(Y : Set (ℝ^k)) → ℝ^k)

def cardSet (k n : ℕ) : Set ℕ :=
  {N | ∀ X : Finset (ℝ^k), IsInGeneralPosition X → N ≤ X.card → HasConvexSubset n X}

noncomputable def f (k n : ℕ) : ℕ := sInf (cardSet k n)

theorem cardSet_mono {k n N M : ℕ} (hN : N ∈ cardSet k n) (hNM : N ≤ M) :
    M ∈ cardSet k n := by
  intro X hX hM
  exact hN X hX (hNM.trans hM)

theorem f_le {k n N : ℕ} (h : N ∈ cardSet k n) : f k n ≤ N :=
  Nat.sInf_le h

theorem erdos_651.variants.pohoata_zakharov {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :

  sorry

end Erdos651

  ∃ a : Fin (Nat.primeCounting n) → ℕ,

  Nat.sInf_le hL

      fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (Real.log n) := by

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

open Filter MeasureTheory Real Set

open scoped Topology

namespace Erdos5

noncomputable def normalizedGap (n : ℕ) : ℝ := primeGap n / log n

def limitPointSet : Set ℝ := {x : ℝ | MapClusterPt x atTop normalizedGap}

theorem erdos_5 : ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C →
    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono n ∧ Tendsto (fun i => normalizedGap (n i)) atTop (𝓝 C) := by
  sorry

theorem mem_limitPointSet_iff (x : ℝ) : x ∈ limitPointSet ↔
    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono n ∧ Tendsto (fun i => normalizedGap (n i)) atTop (𝓝 x) :=
  ⟨fun hx => hx.tendsto_subseq, fun ⟨_n, hn, h⟩ => h.mapClusterPt.of_comp hn.tendsto_atTop⟩

theorem normalizedGap_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ normalizedGap n :=
  div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (log_natCast_nonneg _)

theorem limitPointSet_subset_Ici : limitPointSet ⊆ Ici 0 := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, -, h⟩ := (mem_limitPointSet_iff x).1 hx
  exact ge_of_tendsto' h fun i => normalizedGap_nonneg (n i)

theorem erdos_5_iff_limit_point_set :
    (∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → C ∈ limitPointSet) ↔ limitPointSet = Ici 0 :=
  ⟨fun h => limitPointSet_subset_Ici.antisymm h, fun h _ hC => h ▸ hC⟩

theorem isClosed_limitPointSet : IsClosed limitPointSet := isClosed_setOfPred_clusterPt

theorem dense_iff_limit_point_set :
    Ici (0 : ℝ) ⊆ closure limitPointSet ↔ limitPointSet = Ici 0 := by
  rw [isClosed_limitPointSet.closure_eq]
  exact ⟨fun h => limitPointSet_subset_Ici.antisymm h, fun h => h.ge⟩

-- See also Erdős Problem 234, which concerns the density of the integers `n` with

-- `(p (n + 1) - p n) / log n < c`.

end Erdos5

entries.statement: : ∀ t : ℕ, 3 ≤ t → (fun n ↦ (forcingThreshold n t : ℝ)) ~[atTop] (fun n ↦ (n.choose (t - 1) : ℝ))
entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

namespace Erdos643

open Filter Asymptotics

noncomputable def forcingThreshold (n t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  Hypergraph.extremalNumber n t (fun H ↦ ¬ H.HasRepeatedDisjointUnion) + 1

theorem erdos_643.parts.ii :
    ∀ t : ℕ, 3 ≤ t →
    (fun n ↦ (forcingThreshold n t : ℝ)) ~[atTop]
        (fun n ↦ (n.choose (t - 1) : ℝ)) := by
  sorry

theorem exists_avoiding_maximizer (n t : ℕ) :
    ∃ H : Finset (Finset (Fin n)), H.IsUniform t ∧ ¬ H.HasRepeatedDisjointUnion ∧
      H.card + 1 = forcingThreshold n t := by
  classical
  let S := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard t).powerset.filter
    fun H ↦ ¬ H.HasRepeatedDisjointUnion
  have hne : S.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨∅, ?_⟩
    simp [S, Finset.HasRepeatedDisjointUnion]
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup S hne Finset.card
  have hmem := Finset.mem_filter.1 hH
  refine ⟨H, ?_, hmem.2, ?_⟩
  · intro e he
    exact (Finset.mem_powersetCard.1 (Finset.mem_powerset.1 hmem.1 he)).2
  · unfold forcingThreshold
    apply congrArg (fun k : ℕ ↦ k + 1)
    calc
      H.card = S.sup Finset.card := hmax.symm
      _ = Hypergraph.extremalNumber n t (fun H ↦ ¬ H.HasRepeatedDisjointUnion) := by
        unfold Hypergraph.extremalNumber
        congr 1
        ext K
        simp [S]

theorem forcingThreshold_le_iff (n t m : ℕ) :
    forcingThreshold n t ≤ m ↔
      ∀ H : Finset (Finset (Fin n)), H.IsUniform t →
        m ≤ H.card → H.HasRepeatedDisjointUnion := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hm H hHt hcard
    by_contra hfree
    have hmem : H ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard t).powerset.filter
        (fun H ↦ ¬ H.HasRepeatedDisjointUnion) := by
      refine Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_powerset.2 ?_, hfree⟩
      intro e he
      exact Finset.mem_powersetCard.2 ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hHt e he⟩
    have hmax : H.card < forcingThreshold n t := by
      unfold forcingThreshold
      apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
      unfold Hypergraph.extremalNumber
      apply Finset.le_sup
      simpa using hmem
    omega
  · intro hm
    obtain ⟨H, hHt, hfree, hmax⟩ := exists_avoiding_maximizer n t
    by_contra hlt
    exact hfree (hm H hHt (by omega))

theorem forcingThreshold_eq_one_of_lt {n t : ℕ} (h : n < t) :
    forcingThreshold n t = 1 := by
  classical
  have hempty : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).powersetCard t = ∅ :=
    Finset.powersetCard_eq_empty.2 (by simpa using h)
  simp [forcingThreshold, Hypergraph.extremalNumber, hempty, Finset.HasRepeatedDisjointUnion]

end Erdos643

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

open Filter

namespace Erdos642

def CyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : V) (c : G.Walk v v), c.IsCycle → {e : Sym2 V | c.IsChord e}.ncard < c.length

open scoped Classical in
noncomputable def maxEdges (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter fun G : SimpleGraph (Fin n) => CyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords G).sup
    fun G => G.edgeSet.ncard

theorem erdos_642 :
    (fun n : ℕ => (maxEdges n : ℝ)) =O[atTop] (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) := by
  sorry

theorem cyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords_of_isAcyclic {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : G.IsAcyclic) : CyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords G :=
  fun _ c hc => absurd hc (hG c)

open scoped Classical in
theorem le_maxEdges {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (hG : CyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords G) : G.edgeSet.ncard ≤ maxEdges n := by
  unfold maxEdges
  exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun H : SimpleGraph (Fin n) => H.edgeSet.ncard)
    (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ G, hG⟩)

theorem exists_maxEdges (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin n), CyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords G ∧
      G.edgeSet.ncard = maxEdges n := by
  classical
  have hne : (Finset.univ.filter fun G : SimpleGraph (Fin n) =>
      CyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords G).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨⊥, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩⟩
    exact cyclesHaveMoreVerticesThanChords_of_isAcyclic SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_bot
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup _ hne (fun G => G.edgeSet.ncard)
  exact ⟨G, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hG).2, hmax.symm⟩

theorem maxEdges_le_choose_two (n : ℕ) : maxEdges n ≤ n.choose 2 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, _, hG⟩ := exists_maxEdges n
  rw [← hG]

  {S : Finset ℕ | S.card = k ∧ 0 ∉ S ∧ ∑ n ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / n = 1}.ncard

  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => u n * (u n + 1)

noncomputable def c₀ : ℝ := ⨆ n : ℕ, (u n : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2 ^ n)

theorem F_one : F 1 = 1 := by
  have h : {S : Finset ℕ | S.card = 1 ∧ 0 ∉ S ∧ ∑ n ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / n = 1} =
      {{1}} := by
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Finset.card_eq_one]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, rfl⟩, -, hsum⟩
      simp only [Finset.sum_singleton, one_div, inv_eq_one, Nat.cast_eq_one] at hsum
      rw [hsum]
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨⟨1, rfl⟩, by simp, by simp⟩
  rw [F, h, Set.ncard_singleton]

theorem F_two : F 2 = 0 := by
  have h : {S : Finset ℕ | S.card = 2 ∧ 0 ∉ S ∧ ∑ n ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / n = 1} = ∅ := by
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
    intro hS h0 hsum
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hS
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at h0
    rw [Finset.sum_pair hxy] at hsum
    have hx : (x : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Ne.symm h0.1
    have hy : (y : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Ne.symm h0.2
    rw [div_add_div _ _ hx hy, div_eq_one_iff_eq (mul_ne_zero hx hy)] at hsum
    have e : y + x = x * y := by
      exact_mod_cast (by linear_combination hsum : (y : ℚ) + x = x * y)
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge x 3 with hx3 | hx3
    · interval_cases x <;> omega
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge y 3 with hy3 | hy3
    · interval_cases y <;> omega
    nlinarith
  rw [F, h, Set.ncard_empty]

private lemma eq_two_three_six {x y z : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z)
    (h : (1 : ℚ) / x + 1 / y + 1 / z = 1) : x = 2 ∧ y = 3 ∧ z = 6 := by
  have hx' : (x : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hx.ne'
  have hy' : (y : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : y ≠ 0)
  have hz' : (z : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : z ≠ 0)
  rw [div_add_div _ _ hx' hy', div_add_div _ _ (mul_ne_zero hx' hy') hz',
    div_eq_one_iff_eq (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hx' hy') hz')] at h
  have e : y * z + x * z + x * y = x * y * z := by
    exact_mod_cast (by linear_combination h : (y * z + x * z + x * y : ℚ) = x * y * z)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge x 3 with hx3 | hx3
  · interval_cases x
    · nlinarith
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge y 4 with hy4 | hy4
      · interval_cases y
        exact ⟨rfl, rfl, by omega⟩
      · nlinarith
  · have h1 : x * z < y * z := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hxy (by omega)
    have h2 : x * y < y * z := by nlinarith
    have h3 : 3 * (y * z) ≤ x * (y * z) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hx3
    nlinarith

theorem F_three : F 3 = 1 := by
  have h : {S : Finset ℕ | S.card = 3 ∧ 0 ∉ S ∧ ∑ n ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / n = 1} =
      {{2, 3, 6}} := by
    ext S
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hS, h0, hsum⟩
      obtain ⟨x, y, z, hxy, hxz, hyz, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_three.mp hS
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at h0
      rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hxy, hxz]), Finset.sum_pair hyz] at hsum
      have hx : 0 < x := by omega
      have hy : 0 < y := by omega
      have hz : 0 < z := by omega
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxy with h1 | h1 <;> rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hxz with h2 | h2 <;>
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hyz with h3 | h3
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_two_three_six hx h1 h3 (by linarith); decide
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_two_three_six hx h2 h3 (by linarith); decide
      · omega
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_two_three_six hz h2 h1 (by linarith); decide
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_two_three_six hy h1 h2 (by linarith); decide
      · omega
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_two_three_six hy h3 h2 (by linarith); decide
      · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_two_three_six hz h3 h1 (by linarith); decide
    · rintro rfl
      refine ⟨by decide, by decide, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_insert (by decide), Finset.sum_pair (by decide)]
      norm_num
  rw [F, h, Set.ncard_singleton]

def Covers {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) (S : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) : Prop :=

def closedDisc (r : ℕ) : Set (ℤ × ℤ) :=
  {x : ℤ × ℤ | x.1 ^ 2 + x.2 ^ 2 ≤ (r : ℤ) ^ 2}

noncomputable def coveringRadius {Ω : Type*} (X : ℕ → Ω → ℤ × ℤ) (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ℕ :=

entries.challenge:
import Mathlib

namespace Erdos1049

open ArithmeticFunction Filter

theorem erdos_1049 :
    ∀ t : ℚ, t > 1 → Irrational (∑' n : ℕ+, 1 / ((t : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1)) := by
  sorry

private lemma lambert_convergent (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 < |t|) :
    ∑' n : ℕ+, 1 / (t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1) =
    ∑' n : ℕ+, ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / (t ^ (n : ℕ)) := by
  -- `|t| > 1` implies `t ≠ 0`, hence `t^n ≠ 0` for all n.
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := fun h => by subst h; simp at ht; linarith [abs_nonneg (0:ℝ)]
  have htn : ∀ n : ℕ, t ^ n ≠ 0 := fun n => pow_ne_zero n ht0
  -- Substitution `r := t⁻¹`, so `|r| < 1`.
  set r : ℝ := t⁻¹ with hr_def
  have hr_norm : ‖r‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hr_def, abs_inv]; exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ ht
  -- Apply the Mathlib identity. Now reduce each side of our goal to its form.
  have h := tsum_pow_div_one_sub_eq_tsum_sigma (k := 0) hr_norm
  convert h using 1
  -- LHS: show `1 / (t^n - 1) = r^n / (1 - r^n)`. After substituting `r = 1/t`,
  -- this is the algebraic identity `1/(t^n - 1) = (1/t^n) / (1 - 1/t^n)`,
  -- valid when `t^n ≠ 0` and `t^n ≠ 1`.
  · apply tsum_congr; intro n
    have hp : t ^ (n : ℕ) ≠ 0 := htn n
    have hrn : r ^ (n : ℕ) = (t ^ (n : ℕ))⁻¹ := by rw [hr_def, inv_pow]
    -- `t^n ≠ 1`: would imply `|t|^n = 1`, but `|t| > 1` gives `|t|^n > 1` since `n ≥ 1`.
    have hne1 : t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc
      have ht1 : t ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by linarith [sub_eq_zero.mp hc]
      have habs1 : |t| ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by rw [← abs_pow, ht1]; simp
      have hlt : 1 < |t| ^ (n : ℕ) := one_lt_pow₀ ht n.pos.ne'
      linarith
    rw [hrn]; field_simp
  -- RHS: `σ_0(n) · r^n = τ(n) / t^n` since `σ_0 = τ` and `r = 1/t`.
  · apply tsum_congr; intro n
    have hp : t ^ (n : ℕ) ≠ 0 := htn n
    have hrn : r ^ (n : ℕ) = (t ^ (n : ℕ))⁻¹ := by rw [hr_def, inv_pow]
    rw [hrn, ArithmeticFunction.sigma_zero_apply]; field_simp

private lemma lambert_divergent (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) :
    ∑' n : ℕ+, 1 / (t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1) =
    ∑' n : ℕ+, ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / (t ^ (n : ℕ)) := by
  -- `key`: a function with infinitely many terms bounded away from zero is
  -- not summable. Standard contrapositive of `Summable.tendsto_cofinite_zero`.
  have key : ∀ (f : ℕ+ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
      Set.Infinite {n : ℕ+ | c ≤ |f n|} → ¬Summable f := by
    intro f c hc hinf hsum
    have h := hsum.tendsto_cofinite_zero
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds] at h
    have h1 := h c hc
    rw [Filter.eventually_cofinite] at h1
    refine hinf (h1.subset fun n hn => ?_)
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, not_lt]
    exact hn
  -- Number of divisors of `n ∈ ℕ+` is at least 1 (since `1 ∈ n.divisors`).
  have hcard_pos : ∀ (n : ℕ+), (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    have : 0 < (n : ℕ).divisors.card := by
      apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
      exact ⟨1, Nat.one_mem_divisors.mpr n.2.ne'⟩
    exact_mod_cast this
  -- Case t = 1: LHS terms are 1/0 = 0 by Lean's convention, so LHS sum = 0.
  -- RHS terms are τ(n)/1 = τ(n) ≥ 1, so RHS is non-summable.
  by_cases ht1 : t = 1
  · subst ht1
    have hLzero : ∀ n : ℕ+, (1 : ℝ) / ((1 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1) = 0 := by intro n; simp
    rw [tsum_congr hLzero, tsum_zero]
    symm; apply tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable
    apply key _ 1 (by norm_num)
    convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
    ext n
    simp only [one_pow, div_one, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; exact hcard_pos n
  -- Case t = 0: RHS terms are τ(n)/0 = 0 by Lean's convention, so RHS sum = 0.
  -- LHS terms are 1/(0 - 1) = -1, so LHS is non-summable.
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · subst ht0
    have hRzero : ∀ n : ℕ+, ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / ((0 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ)) = 0 := by
      intro n; rw [zero_pow n.pos.ne']; simp
    rw [tsum_congr hRzero, tsum_zero]
    apply tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable
    apply key _ 1 (by norm_num)
    convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
    ext n
    simp only [zero_pow n.pos.ne', zero_sub, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    norm_num
  -- Case t = -1: alternating signs make `1/(t^n - 1)` vanish at even n but
  -- equal -1/2 at odd n. The set of odd `n ∈ ℕ+` is infinite, which is enough
  -- to invoke `key` on the LHS. RHS magnitude is τ(n) ≥ 1 everywhere.
  by_cases htneg1 : t = -1
  · subst htneg1
    -- Construct the infinite set of odd positive naturals via the injection
    -- `k ↦ 2k + 1`, which lands in `ℕ+` and is always odd.
    have hinf_odd : Set.Infinite {n : ℕ+ | Odd (n : ℕ)} := by
      apply Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem
        (f := fun k : ℕ => (⟨2 * k + 1, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ : ℕ+))
      · intro a b hab; rw [Subtype.mk.injEq] at hab; omega
      · intro k; show Odd (2 * k + 1); exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have hL : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => 1 / (((-1 : ℝ)) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1)) := by
      apply key _ (1/2) (by norm_num)
      apply hinf_odd.mono
      intro n hn
      -- For odd n: (-1)^n = -1, so 1/((-1)^n - 1) = 1/(-2), magnitude 1/2.
      show (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ |1 / ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1)|
      rw [Odd.neg_one_pow hn]; norm_num
    have hR : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ))) := by
      apply key _ 1 (by norm_num)
      convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
      ext n
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      -- |(-1)^n| = 1, so |τ(n) / (-1)^n| = τ(n) ≥ 1.
      rw [abs_div, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, div_one]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      exact hcard_pos n
    rw [tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hL, tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hR]
  -- Remaining case: |t| ≤ 1 with t ∉ {1, 0, -1}, equivalently |t| < 1 and t ≠ 0.
  · -- First narrow `|t| ≤ 1` to `|t| < 1` using the case exclusions.
    have habs_lt : |t| < 1 := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ht with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        rcases (abs_eq zero_le_one).mp h with rfl | rfl
        · exact ht1 rfl
        · exact htneg1 rfl
    have habs_pos : 0 < |t| := abs_pos.mpr ht0
    -- Since `|t| < 1`, `|t^n| ≤ 1` for all `n ∈ ℕ+`.
    have hbound : ∀ (n : ℕ+), |t ^ (n : ℕ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro n; rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) (le_of_lt habs_lt)
    -- Since `|t| < 1` strictly, `t^n ≠ 1` (else `|t|^n = 1` but `|t|^n ≤ |t| < 1`).
    have htn_ne_one : ∀ (n : ℕ+), t ^ (n : ℕ) ≠ 1 := by
      intro n hn
      have h1 : |t ^ (n : ℕ)| = 1 := by rw [hn]; exact abs_one
      rw [abs_pow] at h1
      have hle : |t| ^ (n : ℕ) ≤ |t| := by
        exact pow_le_of_le_one (abs_nonneg _) (le_of_lt habs_lt) n.pos.ne'
      linarith
    have htn_ne_zero : ∀ (n : ℕ+), t ^ (n : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun n => pow_ne_zero _ ht0
    -- LHS: `|t^n - 1| ≤ |t^n| + 1 ≤ 2`, so `|1 / (t^n - 1)| ≥ 1/2` everywhere.
    have hL : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => 1 / (t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1)) := by
      apply key _ (1/2) (by norm_num)
      convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
      ext n
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      have hden_bound : |t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1| ≤ 2 := by
        calc |t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1| ≤ |t ^ (n : ℕ)| + |(1 : ℝ)| := abs_sub _ _
          _ ≤ 1 + 1 := by have := hbound n; rw [abs_one]; linarith
          _ = 2 := by norm_num
      have hden_pos : 0 < |t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1| := by
        rw [abs_pos, sub_ne_zero]; exact htn_ne_one n
      rw [abs_div, abs_one, le_div_iff₀ hden_pos]; linarith
    -- RHS: `|τ(n) / t^n| = τ(n) / |t^n| ≥ τ(n) ≥ 1` since `|t^n| ≤ 1`.
    have hR : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / (t ^ (n : ℕ))) := by
      apply key _ 1 (by norm_num)
      convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
      ext n
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      rw [abs_div, le_div_iff₀ (abs_pos.mpr (htn_ne_zero n))]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ))]
      have := hbound n
      have := hcard_pos n
      nlinarith
    rw [tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hL, tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hR]

theorem lambert_series_eq_num_divisor_sum : ∀ t : ℚ,
     ∑' n : ℕ+, 1 / ((t : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1) =
     ∑' n : ℕ+, (n : ℕ).divisors.card / ((t : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ)) := by
  intro t
  obtain ht | ht := lt_or_ge 1 |(t : ℝ)|
  · exact lambert_convergent (t : ℝ) ht
  · exact lambert_divergent (t : ℝ) ht

end Erdos1049

    have hne1 : t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc
      have ht1 : t ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by linarith [sub_eq_zero.mp hc]
      have habs1 : |t| ^ (n : ℕ) = 1 := by rw [← abs_pow, ht1]; simp
      have hlt : 1 < |t| ^ (n : ℕ) := one_lt_pow₀ ht n.pos.ne'
      linarith
    rw [hrn]; field_simp
  -- RHS: `σ_0(n) · r^n = τ(n) / t^n` since `σ_0 = τ` and `r = 1/t`.
  · apply tsum_congr; intro n
    have hp : t ^ (n : ℕ) ≠ 0 := htn n
    have hrn : r ^ (n : ℕ) = (t ^ (n : ℕ))⁻¹ := by rw [hr_def, inv_pow]
    rw [hrn, ArithmeticFunction.sigma_zero_apply]; field_simp

private lemma lambert_divergent (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) :
    ∑' n : ℕ+, 1 / (t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1) =
    ∑' n : ℕ+, ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / (t ^ (n : ℕ)) := by
  -- `key`: a function with infinitely many terms bounded away from zero is
  -- not summable. Standard contrapositive of `Summable.tendsto_cofinite_zero`.
  have key : ∀ (f : ℕ+ → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
      Set.Infinite {n : ℕ+ | c ≤ |f n|} → ¬Summable f := by
    intro f c hc hinf hsum
    have h := hsum.tendsto_cofinite_zero
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds] at h
    have h1 := h c hc
    rw [Filter.eventually_cofinite] at h1
    refine hinf (h1.subset fun n hn => ?_)
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, not_lt]
    exact hn
  -- Number of divisors of `n ∈ ℕ+` is at least 1 (since `1 ∈ n.divisors`).
  have hcard_pos : ∀ (n : ℕ+), (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    have : 0 < (n : ℕ).divisors.card := by
      apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
      exact ⟨1, Nat.one_mem_divisors.mpr n.2.ne'⟩
    exact_mod_cast this
  -- Case t = 1: LHS terms are 1/0 = 0 by Lean's convention, so LHS sum = 0.
  -- RHS terms are τ(n)/1 = τ(n) ≥ 1, so RHS is non-summable.
  by_cases ht1 : t = 1
  · subst ht1
    have hLzero : ∀ n : ℕ+, (1 : ℝ) / ((1 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1) = 0 := by intro n; simp
    rw [tsum_congr hLzero, tsum_zero]
    symm; apply tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable
    apply key _ 1 (by norm_num)
    convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
    ext n
    simp only [one_pow, div_one, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; exact hcard_pos n
  -- Case t = 0: RHS terms are τ(n)/0 = 0 by Lean's convention, so RHS sum = 0.
  -- LHS terms are 1/(0 - 1) = -1, so LHS is non-summable.
  by_cases ht0 : t = 0
  · subst ht0
    have hRzero : ∀ n : ℕ+, ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / ((0 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ)) = 0 := by
      intro n; rw [zero_pow n.pos.ne']; simp
    rw [tsum_congr hRzero, tsum_zero]
    apply tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable
    apply key _ 1 (by norm_num)
    convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
    ext n
    simp only [zero_pow n.pos.ne', zero_sub, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    norm_num
  -- Case t = -1: alternating signs make `1/(t^n - 1)` vanish at even n but
  -- equal -1/2 at odd n. The set of odd `n ∈ ℕ+` is infinite, which is enough
  -- to invoke `key` on the LHS. RHS magnitude is τ(n) ≥ 1 everywhere.
  by_cases htneg1 : t = -1
  · subst htneg1
    -- Construct the infinite set of odd positive naturals via the injection
    -- `k ↦ 2k + 1`, which lands in `ℕ+` and is always odd.
    have hinf_odd : Set.Infinite {n : ℕ+ | Odd (n : ℕ)} := by
      apply Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem
        (f := fun k : ℕ => (⟨2 * k + 1, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ : ℕ+))
      · intro a b hab; rw [Subtype.mk.injEq] at hab; omega
      · intro k; show Odd (2 * k + 1); exact ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have hL : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => 1 / (((-1 : ℝ)) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1)) := by
      apply key _ (1/2) (by norm_num)
      apply hinf_odd.mono
      intro n hn
      -- For odd n: (-1)^n = -1, so 1/((-1)^n - 1) = 1/(-2), magnitude 1/2.
      show (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ |1 / ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1)|
      rw [Odd.neg_one_pow hn]; norm_num
    have hR : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ))) := by
      apply key _ 1 (by norm_num)
      convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
      ext n
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      -- |(-1)^n| = 1, so |τ(n) / (-1)^n| = τ(n) ≥ 1.
      rw [abs_div, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow, div_one]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      exact hcard_pos n
    rw [tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hL, tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hR]
  -- Remaining case: |t| ≤ 1 with t ∉ {1, 0, -1}, equivalently |t| < 1 and t ≠ 0.
  · -- First narrow `|t| ≤ 1` to `|t| < 1` using the case exclusions.
    have habs_lt : |t| < 1 := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ht with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        rcases (abs_eq zero_le_one).mp h with rfl | rfl
        · exact ht1 rfl
        · exact htneg1 rfl
    have habs_pos : 0 < |t| := abs_pos.mpr ht0
    -- Since `|t| < 1`, `|t^n| ≤ 1` for all `n ∈ ℕ+`.
    have hbound : ∀ (n : ℕ+), |t ^ (n : ℕ)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro n; rw [abs_pow]; exact pow_le_one₀ (abs_nonneg _) (le_of_lt habs_lt)
    -- Since `|t| < 1` strictly, `t^n ≠ 1` (else `|t|^n = 1` but `|t|^n ≤ |t| < 1`).
    have htn_ne_one : ∀ (n : ℕ+), t ^ (n : ℕ) ≠ 1 := by
      intro n hn
      have h1 : |t ^ (n : ℕ)| = 1 := by rw [hn]; exact abs_one
      rw [abs_pow] at h1
      have hle : |t| ^ (n : ℕ) ≤ |t| := by
        exact pow_le_of_le_one (abs_nonneg _) (le_of_lt habs_lt) n.pos.ne'
      linarith
    have htn_ne_zero : ∀ (n : ℕ+), t ^ (n : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun n => pow_ne_zero _ ht0
    -- LHS: `|t^n - 1| ≤ |t^n| + 1 ≤ 2`, so `|1 / (t^n - 1)| ≥ 1/2` everywhere.
    have hL : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => 1 / (t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1)) := by
      apply key _ (1/2) (by norm_num)
      convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
      ext n
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      have hden_bound : |t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1| ≤ 2 := by
        calc |t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1| ≤ |t ^ (n : ℕ)| + |(1 : ℝ)| := abs_sub _ _
          _ ≤ 1 + 1 := by have := hbound n; rw [abs_one]; linarith
          _ = 2 := by norm_num
      have hden_pos : 0 < |t ^ (n : ℕ) - 1| := by
        rw [abs_pos, sub_ne_zero]; exact htn_ne_one n
      rw [abs_div, abs_one, le_div_iff₀ hden_pos]; linarith
    -- RHS: `|τ(n) / t^n| = τ(n) / |t^n| ≥ τ(n) ≥ 1` since `|t^n| ≤ 1`.
    have hR : ¬ Summable (fun n : ℕ+ => ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ) / (t ^ (n : ℕ))) := by
      apply key _ 1 (by norm_num)
      convert Set.infinite_univ (α := ℕ+)
      ext n
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
      rw [abs_div, le_div_iff₀ (abs_pos.mpr (htn_ne_zero n))]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ((n : ℕ).divisors.card : ℝ))]
      have := hbound n
      have := hcard_pos n
      nlinarith
    rw [tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hL, tsum_eq_zero_of_not_summable hR]

theorem lambert_series_eq_num_divisor_sum : ∀ t : ℚ,
     ∑' n : ℕ+, 1 / ((t : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1) =
     ∑' n : ℕ+, (n : ℕ).divisors.card / ((t : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ)) := by
  intro t
  obtain ht | ht := lt_or_ge 1 |(t : ℝ)|
  · exact lambert_convergent (t : ℝ) ht
  · exact lambert_divergent (t : ℝ) ht

end Erdos1049
